sanskrit: yanna sarveṣu tantreṣu yāmalādiṣu bhāṣitam tattvaṃ śrīṣoḍaśākṣaryāḥ sarvasvaṃ mama pārvati bhogāpavargadaṃ loke sādhakānāṃ sukhāvaham [k: śubhāvaham] tvatprasādānmayā jñātaṃ tattvaṃ devyāḥ sudurlabham parādevīrahasyākhyaṃ dīkṣāpūrvaṃ vadasva me yena śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet vicārya vidhivaddhīmān dīkṣākarma samācaret parādevyā paśutvena mohitaṃ vigataspṛham kaulikaḥ paśubhāvena mukto jñānaṃ bhajet tataḥ dīkṣitaḥ sa bhavejjñānī dīkṣāhīno bhavet paśuḥ sa jātu nottared devi nirayāmbunidheḥ kvacit pāpaugho'ntikamāyāti puṇyaṃ dūraṃ palāyate bālye vā yauvane vāpi vārdhakye'pi sureśvari ataḥ paśurmanuṣyaḥ san paśuyoniṃ vrajecchive gurumanveṣayed devi kaulikācāradīkṣitam nirāmayaṃ ca nirlobhaṃ niḥśeṣāgamapāragam siddhasādhyārinirṇītāṃ dīkṣāṃ devyā yathāvidhi guruśca śiṣyaṃ ramyāṅgaṃ kulīnaṃ garbhadīkṣitam devībhaktirataṃ bhaktaṃ pāpabhītaṃ kṛtātmakam yasya citte parā bhaktirgururnāsti tathāvidhaḥ [kh: tathā vidhiḥ] bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ sa kiṃ deva kariṣyati gurorabhāve deveśi pustakaṃ gurumācaret dīkṣitaḥ śivamantreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ pustakaṃ tu guruṃ kuryāt sa bhavecchivaghātakaḥ mūrkhaṃ lobhātmakaṃ devi kulīnaṃ ca parityajet

sodarasya kaniṣṭhasya mātulasya viśeṣataḥ paralokecchayā kuryāt paralokabhayāya vā kadā dīkṣā parā grāhyā sādhakaistadvadasva me navarātridine pitroḥ śrāddhe svajanivāsare tiṣye svajanmanakṣatre dīkṣāṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ gatvā nadītaṭaṃ divyaṃ latākusumasundaram devatāyatanaṃ vāpi prāpyāśu praṇamet tataḥ vedīmīśānadigbhāge catuṣkoṇāṃ manoharām sindūreṇa śive yantraṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaran gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāḥ śive tāramāyāramābījairdhūpadīpaprasūnakaiḥ mahāvidyāṃ ca deveśi ṣaṭkoṇeṣu prapūjayet gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ devi tadagre'pi sarasvatīm bindau śrīmūlamantreṇa parādevīṃ prapūjayet gandhākṣataprasūnādyairdhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ aṣṭapatreṣu deveśi saṃpūjyā aṣṭa mātaraḥ brāhmī nārāyaṇī caiva kaumārī cāparājitā vāmāvartakrameṇaivaṃ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ mahākālaṃ ca kālāgniṃ karālaṃ vikarālakam saṃpūjya vidhivat tatra gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ pūrve tataḥ khanet kuṇḍaṃ yonirūpaṃ trikoṇakam tāraṃ vahnitrayaṃ cāgne vaiśvānarapadaṃ vadet iha sannidhimādhatsva varaṃ me dehi-yugmakam parādevyāstu mantreṇa ghṛtamājyaṃ carecchive ghṛtakhaṇḍādimṛdvīkākharjūrāmbujapāyasaiḥ

prāṅmukho gururāsīna uttarābhimukhaṃ śiśum bhūtaśuddhikramopetaṃ prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caret tatra mūlena deveśi diśo baddhvā parāṃ smaret vahneḥ samakṣaṃ yantrāgre dīkṣāṃ paramadurlabhām ānandāsaktahṛdayaḥ śanaistristriḥ samarpayet tato devyāśca gāyatrīṃ tato mūlaṃ maheśvari śiṣyo dīkṣāṃ tu saṃprāpya gurumabhyarcya śaktitaḥ tadājñāṃ sahasādāya japāya parameśvari punarjātu śive śiṣyo gurave'pi na darśayet bhūtān santarpya balinā devīṃ [kh: devīdevaṃ] devaṃ visarjayet gaṇeśaṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ mūlavidyāṃ japet param kāṃ kāṃ vidyāṃ sa gṛhṇīyācchindhyetat saṃśayaṃ mama gaṇeśaṃ devi gāyatrīṃ mūlavidyāṃ japet param guroḥ pādaprasādena labdhvā katipayairdinaiḥ prārthanābhiśca saṃtoṣya śrīvidyāṃ prārthayet tataḥ adīkṣitaḥ paśuḥ proktaḥ paśutvānnirayī bhavet śrīvidyāṃ prārthayitvādau gṛhṇīyāt sarvasiddhaye saśivāṃ girije sāṅgāṃ prārthayed dakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ dvāviṃśatyakṣarīṃ vidyāṃ prajapet sādhakottamaḥ tāmasī kālikā proktā rājasī ṣoḍaśākṣarī rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ deyā santatirarthine vidyāṃ tripurasundaryā labdhvā guruprasādataḥ śyāmāṃ bhajet parāvidyāṃ śrīvidyābhedarūpiṇīm yanna dṛṣṭyāpi vai brūyādgurustanna [k: tatra] samācaret gurumullaṅghya yaḥ kuryāt kiñcit sa nirayaṃ vrajet

gurūpadeśataḥ kuryāj japaṃ pūjāmaharniśam gurumabhyarcya saṃprārthya śaktidīkṣārthamīśvari janmakoṭiṣu japtāpi tasya vidyā na sidhyati śiṣyastriyaṃ parārūpāṃ devīrūpāṃ vicintayet ādṛtya mātṛvad devi kanyāvad dīkṣayet tadā upaviśya gurustatra paścimābhimukhaḥ śive tataḥ saṃpūjya deveśi yantrāgre devatāgṛhe saṃprāpya saśivāṃ vidyāṃ guruṃ pitṛvadarcayet tadājñāṃ śirasādāya japaṃ kuryāttu sarvadā martyo'pi sañchive janturamaratvamavāpnuyāt sa śyāmā sa śivā devi vaśyaṃ tasya jagat trayam dīkṣāvidhermahādevi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ devīnāṃ vaiṣṇavāñchāktāñchaivāṃstvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati kālikā bhadrakālī ca mātaṅgī bhuvaneśvarī annapūrṇā mahālakṣmīḥ śārikā śāradā tataḥ bhīḍā ca kālarātriśca bhavānī vajrayoginī etāsāṃ devi sāṅgānāṃ śaktīnāṃ vacmyahaṃ manūn mṛtyuñjayo'mṛteśāno vaṭuko'pi maheśvaraḥ vikarālo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śarvaḥ paśupatirmṛḍaḥ kumāraḥ krodhanaśceśaḥ kapālī krūrabhairavaḥ aghoraśca mahākālaḥ kāmeśvara iti smṛtaḥ yena [kh: yeṣāṃ] śravaṇamātreṇa mantrī viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet varāho jāmadagnyaśca sītārāmo janārdanaḥ mantrā atyuttamā [k: abhyuttamāḥ] devi japyāḥ sādhakasattamaiḥ uddhārān vacmi mantrāṇāṃ śrutvā gopaya yatnataḥ

namo'nte devi bālāyā mantro'yaṃ cāṣṭavarṇakaḥ chaviḥ śaktiḥ śiraḥ kāntistamo māyā śarat śiraḥ [kh: śubhadostu] pūrṇaḥ nityāyāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyā vāgbhavīkāmaśaktayaḥ mantro'yaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ sarvasādhāraṇo mataḥ kālītrayaṃ kūrcayugmaṃ lajjāyugmaṃ samuccaret ṭhadvayaṃ syānmanorante mantro'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaraḥ anyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt kālikāpūjane param bhadrakālipadaṃ brūyād bījāni pratilomataḥ pūjanīyā mahādevi bhadrakālīsamarcane mama sarvārthasiddhiṃ ca dehi-yugmaṃ samuddharet ekākṣarīyaṃ viditā bhuvane bhuvaneśvarī tāraṃ parāṃ vadhūṃ kūrcaṃ turagaṃ sakalāñcale tārakāntātaṭaiḥ pūjyāḥ śaktayaścakramadhyagāḥ vajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭsvāhayā yute vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca tathocchiṣṭa-padaṃ vadet mahāpiśācini ceti māyārṇaṃ paṅkajatrayam vākkāmabījaiḥ saṃpūjyāḥ śaktayo'nyāḥ parasparam sarasvatyai jaganmantraḥ prasiddho'yaṃ śivākṣaraḥ tāraṃ parāpi kamalā kāmaṃ viśvaṃ tato vadet ādibījadvayenaiva pūjyā devyāḥ samīpagāḥ mahālakṣmi prasīdeti yugmaṃ mā paṅkajatrayam ādibījatrayeṇaiva pūjyāḥ paramaśaktayaḥ nāmāśmarīṃ manorante mantro'yaṃ bhuvi durlabhaḥ tāraṃ māyā smaraḥ śaktiraśmarī nāma saṃvadet

tārakāmaiḥ śive pūjyāḥ śaktayaḥ paramārthadāḥ indrākṣi vajrahaste ca haramante'gnivallabhā jihvāṃ kīlaya-yugmaṃ ca mṛttāraṃ ṭhadvayaṃ manuḥ praṇavastārakā jyotistārā madhye'bhidhaṃ nyaset praṇavenārcayed devi parivārān yathākramam bhagavatyai ca rājñyai ca māyā ṭhadvayamañcale tāraṃ lajjāṃ śriyaṃ caiva jvālāmukhi mameti ca tāreṇa pūjayed devi parivāragatāḥ parāḥ bhīḍābhagavatītyevaṃ haṃsarūpiṇi ṭhadvayam praṇavaṃ vāsanā māyā manmathaḥ kamalā tataḥ vīryaṃ dehi punarnāma gaṇeśvaryāśmarī smṛtā tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ tāraṃ māyā ramā ramā mābījaiḥ pūjayed devi parivāragatāḥ parāḥ mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhīśaḥ sādhakānāṃ jayapradaḥ candravāhlīkamohārṇacandrā madhye'bhidhaṃ nyaset vāsanāmohabījena pūjayet parivāragān śaktirnāmāśmarīmantraḥ siddhalakṣmyā udāhṛtaḥ tāraṃ kāmo ḍimbalakṣmīḥ kūrcaṃ kāṃkṣābhidhaṃ tataḥ kāmena pūjayed devi parivārān yathākramam [k: kramāt] mama varaṃ dehi-yugmaṃ haraṃ nīramayaṃ manuḥ tāraṃ ramā vāgurārṇaṃ nāma madhye tataḥ parā vāgurārṇeṇa deveśi pūjayet parivāragāḥ gauri śarvo vanaṃ devi mantraḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ bhekī tamaḥ parā śaktiḥ khecaryai cāśmarī tataḥ parayā pūjayed devīḥ parivāragatāḥ priye

haraṃ nīraṃ manorante mantro'yaṃ vākpradāyakaḥ tāraṃ ramā parā kāmaḥ śaktirvastraṃ tato'bhidham mūlena pūjayedanyā devīstatparivāragāḥ adhunā te manūn śaivān vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati guhyātiguhyaguptaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ svayonivat paṭalaḥ mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi tasyāhaṃ śṛṇu pārvati mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuñjayasya yena vijñātamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāt mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhīśaḥ sumukhīśivavallabhaḥ āpaduddhāraṇāyeti kuruyugmaṃ samuccaret tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ mahādevi tato maheśvarāya ca tāraṃ viśvaṃ śivāyeti mantro'yaṃ bhogamokṣadaḥ viśvamante smṛto mantro mantramaulimaṇiḥ paraḥ ante ṭhadvayamīśāni mantro'yaṃ devadurlabhaḥ mantraḥ śivaprado devi śaivānāṃ paramārthadaḥ mantro bhairavavikhyātaḥ kalau bhogāpavargadaḥ ante ṭhadvayamuccārya mantrarājo'yamīritaḥ durgeśanīlakaṇṭhasya mantroddhāro daśākṣaraḥ ante'śmarī manordevi mantro'yaṃ bhogadaḥ smṛtaḥ mantro'yaṃ devadevasya vallabho muktisādhanam tāraṃ hṛjjaṃ parā lakṣmīrmadhye brūyātpinākine tāraṃ śivo maṭhaṃ devi giriśāyāśmarī manuḥ māyā śivākṣaraṃ māyā mahāgaṇapamuddharet tāraṃ parā ca vāhlīkaṃ pramathādhipamuddharet

chaviḥ kumārāya manorante viśvaṃ manuḥ paraḥ tāraṃ kālī śivo devi krodhaneśāya cāśmarī tāraṃ parā ramā lakṣmīrīśāyeti vanaṃ manuḥ ante ṭhadvayamuddhṛtya mantro'yaṃ syād daśākṣaraḥ prasīda-dvayamāpo'nte mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ mantro'yaṃ devadevasya varṇitaste daśākṣaraḥ tāraṃ ca bhāsvatī māyā bhargāyānte'śmarī manuḥ praṇavaṃ kamalā māyā kālāgnaye-padaṃ tataḥ tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ śivo devi sadyojātāya cāśmarī rātryabdhīndujasindumatsyakuliśā mantro'yamāghorikaḥ māyādvayaṃ vahnijāyā rājarājeśvaro manuḥ tārayuktaviparītabījakaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaravidhiḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nacākhyeyaṃ durātmane paṭalaḥ yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa dīkṣito dīkṣito bhavet aṣṭasiddhipradaṃ sadyaḥ sādhakānāṃ sudurlabham lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyeti viśvamante manuḥ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇāya kūrcaṃ haraṭhadvayaṃ syācchrīkṛṣṇamantro manurājamauliḥ devadevasya mantro'yaṃ viṣṇostava samīritaḥ turyāṅkitaṃ vāk taṭaphaḍvanaṃ te prokto hi lakṣmīnarasiṃhamantraḥ ante'śmarī vaiṣṇavadhāmadāyī lakṣmīvarāhasya manuḥ smṛtaste āpastathānte gadito'yamīḍhyo yatheṣṭado bhārgavarāmamantraḥ prasīda-yugamāpo'nte mantro'yaṃ muktikāraṇam viśvamante manordevi mantro'yaṃ ripusūdanaḥ kūrcaṃ padmatrayaṃ nīraṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sudurlabhaḥ

vāsudevāya viśvaṃ syānmantro'yaṃ bhogamokṣadaḥ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ yena vijñātamātreṇa vidyā sidhyati sattvaram adātavyamabhaktebhyo nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit vaiṣṇavānāṃ manūnāṃ tu vakṣyāmyutkīlanaṃ param vāṇīmante triruccārya bhavedutkīlanaṃ manoḥ bhavet tripurabhairavyā manorutkīlanaṃ param japecchrīṣoḍaśākṣaryā bhavedutkīlanaṃ manoḥ niṣkīlitā syādvidyeyaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarī parā bhadrakālīmanordevi bhavedutkīlanaṃ tathā bhavedutkīlanaṃ devi rājamātaṅginīmanoḥ manoḥ śrībhuvaneśvaryāḥ syādutkīlanamuttamam ayamutkīlano mantrastārāyāḥ samudāhṛtaḥ chinnaśīrṣāmanoreṣa syādutkīlanakaḥ paraḥ sumukhyā mantrarājasya bhavedutkīlanaṃ tathā sarasvatīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ annapūrṇāmanoreṣa syādutkīlanako manuḥ mahālakṣmīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ śāradāmantrarājasya mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ indrākṣīmantrarājasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ mantro'yaṃ bagalāmukhyā mantrotkīlanasiddhidaḥ turīmantrasya mantro'yamutkīlanaphalapradaḥ japenmantraṃ mahārājñīmanūtkīlanasiddhaye manuḥ]

bhīḍāmantrasya mantro'yamutkīlanaphalapradaḥ kālarātrimanordevi syādutkīlanako manuḥ bhavānīmantrarājasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣanut utkīlanākhyo mantro'yaṃ mantrasiddhiphalapradaḥ vārāhīmantrarājasya mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ siddhalakṣmīrmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ utkīlanākhyo mantro'yaṃ kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥ padmāvatīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ kubjikāmantrarājasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣahṛt mantraṃ japedayaṃ mantro gaurīmantrasya kīlahṛt khecarīmantrarājasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ manornīlasarasvatyāḥ syādutkīlanako manuḥ parāśaktermanordevi kīladoṣāpaho manuḥ niṣkīlitā mayā khyātāḥ kecit pārvati kīlitāḥ vikarālaḥ śivo śarvo mṛḍaḥ paśupatistathā krodheśa īśa īśāni kapālī krūrabhairavaḥ ete mantrā mahādevi kīladoṣavivarjitāḥ athavā devadeveśi vakṣye tattvaṃ parāt param mantrādibījaṃ deveśi pratimantraṃ japet sudhīḥ mṛtyuñjayo'mṛteśāno vaṭuko nīlakaṇṭhakaḥ mahākālo mahādevi kāmeśvara iti priye eteṣāṃ śṛṇu mantrāṇāṃ deveśyutkīlanaṃ param hṛjjabījaṃ japedādau ante śaktiṃ japet priye tāramante japedādau śaktiṃ mantrasya pārvati sādhakottamaḥ

haritaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā mantrānte ca śivaṃ japet śivamādau japedante tāraṃ pārvati sādhakaḥ māyāmante japed devi śivamādau ca sādhakaḥ viśvamādau manordevi mātrādiṃ cāñcale japet eṣāmapi mahākālo niṣkīlita iti smṛtaḥ kāmeśakūṭatrayataḥ prathamārṇatrayaṃ japet pārvati haritaṃ prathamaṃ dadyādante praṇavaimīśvari śaktimādau manorante vāgbhavaṃ sādhako japet parāyugaṃ japedante viśvamādau japenmanoḥ smaramādau japedante nṛbījaṃ sādhakottamaḥ tāramante ramāmādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ kucabījaṃ japedādau mantrānte padmayugmakam parāmante ramāmādau japet pārvati siddhaye māmante prathamaṃ māṃ ca japet pārvati sādhakaḥ lakṣmīmādau parāmante sakṛduccārayet sudhīḥ kāmamādau ca mantrānte tāraṃ devi japet sudhīḥ tava snehena kathitaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ paṭalaḥ eṣāmuccāramātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet sañjīvanākhyo mantro'yaṃ divyo mantrasya siddhaye kūṭatrayāṇāṃ deveśi trikūṭāyā japet sudhīḥ siddhavidyā mahāśyāmā sarvadoṣavivarjitā bhadrikāyugalaṃ devi dadyādante manoḥ śive tāraṃ parāṃ paṭhedante japādau sādhakeśvari

vāratrayaṃ paṭhedādau mūlamantrasya vai parām mantrasyāsya maheśvari vāsanāṃ mūlamantrasya japedante maheśvari parāmādau japed devi kāmamante tathaiva ca tāradvayaṃ japenmantrī mantrānte māntrikeśvari viśvamante japedādau ṭhadvayaṃ kālikeśvari vāṇīmante japedādau kāmarājaṃ ca sādhakaḥ kūrcamādau parāmante japet sādhakasattamaḥ kāmarājaṃ japedādau māyābījaṃ tathāñcale manmathaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca japedādau ca sādhakaḥ mṛtsnābījaṃ japed devi praṇavaṃ ca vanāñcale tārakaṃ mūlamantrānte triruccārya japet priye vahnibījaṃ japedante śaktimādau maheśvari kūrcamādau ca turagaṃ japedante maheśvari vāgbhavaṃ praṇavādau ca ṭhadvayānte japet parām tāramante ramāmādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ [kh: tatparam] māyāmuccārya deveśi trirādau tristathāñcale maṭhamante maṭhaṃ cādau japet pārvati kaulikaḥ haritaṃ mūlamantrānte japedādau ca manmatham kāṅkṣāmādau ramāmante japet sādhakasattamaḥ kāmamādau mahādevi japedante ramāṃ śive vāgurāṃ paṅkajānte ca praṇavādau parāṃ japet vāhlīkaṃ praṇavādau ca mūlānte tu [kh: nte'pi] śivaṃ japet kūṭamante viśvamādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ vāṇīmādau parāmante japenmāntrikasattamaḥ

vāgbhavaṃ praṇavādau ca kāmamante japet śive adhunā śaivamantrāṇāṃ niṣkīlānāṃ maheśvari mūlamantrāñcale mantrī japet tāraṃ pṛthak pṛthak tathāpi kīlitānāṃ te sañjīvanamanūn bruve sūryanāmākṣaradvandvaṃ japedādau ca sādhakaḥ viśvamādau viśvamante japenmāntrikanāyakaḥ vaṭukāyeti tārādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ śivaṃ ca praṇavādau tu japet sādhakavandite parāmādau triruccārya japādau sañjapet sudhīḥ śivamante dviruccārya japed devi japāditaḥ vajrabījāni mūlādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ nirdoṣo mantrarājo'yaṃ mahākālasya pārvati kūṭatrayebhyo deveśi dvitīyākṣaramuccaret athāhaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu manūnāṃ vacmi jīvanam haritaṃ mūlamantrāntaṃ japet pārvati sādhakaḥ śaktimante manorādau vāgbhavaṃ sādhako japet viśvānte praṇavaṃ devi japet sādhakasattamaḥ nṛbījaṃ prathamaṃ devi praṇavaṃ cāñcale japet ramāmante triruccārya japedānandanirbhare parāyugaṃ japedādau mantrarājasya pārvati mantrānte praṇavaṃ devi tārādau sakalāṃ japet viśvamādau parāmante japet pārvati māntrikaḥ parāmādau parāmante satārāṃ sādhako japet ramāmādau ramāmante japādau sañjapet sudhīḥ tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat

paṭalaḥ sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ kalau nistejasāṃ śṛṇu tirpurā yāsti sā kālī śyāmā saiva parā smṛtā vimocaya haraṃ nīraṃ bālāśāpaharī smṛtā turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi bhairavīśāpamocanam sadāśivasya śāpaṃ ca mocaya dvayamuddharet śyāmā paramavidyeyaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarī parā tathāpi durlabhāṃ vidyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ śāpahāriṇīm kālīṃ kūrcaṃ paraṃ nāma dakṣiṇe kālike tathā kālīṃ kūrcaṃ parāṃ nīrameṣā syācchāpahāriṇī śāpaṃ mocaya yugmāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī turagaṃ nīramante tu vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī māyāṃ syādbhuvaneśvaryā vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī vimocayāpastārāyā vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocayāpo mayākhyātaṃ chinnamastāṅkamocanam parāṃ nīramiyaṃ vidyā sumukhyāḥ śāpahāriṇī durvāsaḥśāpaṃ muñcāśu ṭhadvayaṃ śāpamocanam kūrcaṃ haraṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī turagaṃ nīramīśāni vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śaktirnīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī tāraṃ mṛdaṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī tārakaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī vimocaya vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī

kūrcaṃ nīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śāpaṃ mocaya nīraṃ ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī kūrcaṃ haraṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī maṭhaṃ nīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī vāṇī śarat smaro nīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śivaśāpaṃ ca muñcāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śāpaṃ muñcayugaṃ nīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī nīramante mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī nīramante manordevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocayāpo manorante vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī vimocaya śarannīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī sarvasādhāraṇīṃ vidyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ śāpahāriṇīm yasyā uccāramātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śaradhṛjjaṃ ca tāraṃ ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī yugmamante tathā tāraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī dvayaṃ ca devīpraṇavo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī vanamante mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī tāraṃ parāmādyabījaṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī

vidyāṃ śāpaharīṃ sadyo mantrasiddhirbhaved yataḥ mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī tāraṃ ṭhadvayamante ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca [kh: po'nte] vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpo'nte vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī haraṃ ṭhadvayamante ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī guhyaṃ sarvasvamīśāni gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ paṭalaḥ yena sādhitamātreṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate puraskriyājapenaiva cettāṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamaḥ paratra sādhako devi bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ svagṛhaṃ svaguruṃ nītvā natvā pādau maheśvari sindūreṇa likhet tryasraṃ guruṃ tatra niveśayet viśvamante mahādevi gurumantro'yamuttamaḥ mātṛkābhiḥ samaṃ devi yathāsthāneṣu pārvati guruṃ santoṣayet tatra dakṣiṇābhiḥ kulāmṛtaiḥ ravau prātarmahādevi guruṃ natvā ca sādhakaḥ śivaśaktyoḥ pṛthag devi japaṃ saṃpādya sādhakaḥ tato devi japenmantrī chandomunimanuṃ tataḥ tarpayitvā daśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ japāt siddhirjapāt siddhirjapāt siddhirmaheśvari

pārāyaṇajapenāsti yādṛśī mantriṇāṃ śive pārāyaṇajapaṃ brūhi yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā yena siddhiyuto mantrī bhavedbhairavasannibhaḥ teṣāṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ vakṣye yena brahmamayo bhavet tasyaiva saguṇasyātra cintanaṃ ghaṭikājapaḥ siddhaḥ sādhya iti smṛtvā japet pārāyaṇaṃ manum tadādi nityaṃ ghaṭikaikamānāt pratyakṣaraṃ yāti dine dine'rkaḥ tribhāgamādyantarayostathānte vidhāya mantrasya japenmumukṣuḥ ghaṭīpramāṇāḥ kulamātṛkāyā bhavanti varṇā manurājasiddhyaiḥ mūlavidyāṃ japenmantrī śivaśaktimayīṃ śive pañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarīmūlān pañcanādātmako bhavet vidyānte'pi tyajedvidyāṃ śivarūpāṃ śivo bhavet tadā prabhṛti loke'smin mātṛkāsu caredraviḥ lakṣmīṃ prāpya śivo mantrī saubhāgyāntāṃ yathākramam haṃsāntāṃ sañjaped devi mantrī mātṛkayā sadā mahāśrīṣoḍaśīvidyāmaṣṭabhūtimayīṃ parām brahmavidyālayotthānaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ paṭalaḥ yaṃ vijñāya bhaved devi sarvasaukhyamayaḥ sudhīḥ bālātripurasundaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ sādhyastripurabhairavyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ mahātripurasundaryā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ sarvadoṣavinirmuktā purāpi kathitaṃ mayā bhadrakālyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti sundari [ṅ: pārvati] rājamātaṅginīdevyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ

mantro'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyaḥ susiddhidaḥ ugratārāmanoreṣa mantraḥ śrīsaṃpuṭābhidhaḥ mantro'yaṃ chinnamastāyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'tidurlabhaḥ devyā ucchiṣṭamātaṅgyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ sarasvatyā manordevi mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ annapūrṇāmanoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ devatāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ śārikāmūlamantrasya mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥ śāradāyāḥ sarasvatyā'mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ indrākṣyā vajrahastāyā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ śrīdevyā bagalāmukhyā mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥ mahāturyā manoreṣa saṃpuṭākhyo'sti siddhidaḥ mahārājñyā manoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ jvālāmukhyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti pārvati saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ mantro bhīḍāyā devadurlabhaḥ kālarātrimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇam bhavānīmūlamantrasya saṃpuṭo'yaṃ mayeritaḥ saṃpuṭo varṇito devi śrīvajrayoginīmanoḥ mantro'yaṃ dhūmravārāhyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥ siddhalakṣmīmanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥ padmāvatīmanoreṣa mantraḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ kubjikāmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ gaurīmantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā khecarīmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ

manornīlasarasvatyāḥ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā parāśaktimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇam sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye saṃpuṭaṃ surapūjite sarveṣāṃ śaivamantrāṇāṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ mṛtyuñjayamanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā amṛteśvaramantrasya saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ saṃpuṭākhyo manuḥ prokto vaṭukasya mayā śive mantro'yaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥ sadyojātasya mantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ mahāgaṇapatereṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ mantro'styaghoradevasya varṇitaḥ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ śrīkāmeśvaramantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ niṣkīlito mahākālamantro doṣavivarjitaḥ vakṣye saṃpuṭamantrāṃśca sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā lakṣmīnārāyaṇamanormantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ lakṣmīvarāhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ jāmadagnyamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ śrīsītārāmamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ śrījanārdanamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ viśvaksenamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ śrīvāsudevamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ tava snehena nirṇītaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ

yena sādhitamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet puraścaraṇahīno hi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana ardharātre'pi madhyāhne puraścaraṇamārabhet svaguruṃ pūjayitvādau puraścaryāṃ samārabhet catuṣkoṇāmīśadiśi svahastaparivistṛtām likhed bindutryasramādau ṣaḍaśraṃ vṛttamaṇḍalam puraścaryāyantrametadgaditaṃ girije mayā indrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥ pūjyā sahetayo devi dharābhavanamaṇḍale vārāhī caṇḍikā devi pūjanīyāparājitā pārvatī kubjikā durgā cāmuṇḍā nīlatāriṇī gaṅgā ca yamunā devi pūjyā tryaśre sarasvatī mūlamantreṇa gandhārghyapuṣpadhūpādidīpakaiḥ vedīvidikṣu saṃsthāpya mantrī ghaṭacatuṣṭayam vahninirṛtivāteśakrameṇaivaṃ samarcayet svasvamūlena deveśi tatra pūjāṃ tathāhnikīm śrīcakraṃ pūjayitvādau tataḥ kuryājjapaṃ sudhīḥ brahmacaryadharo mantrī dhyāyan devīṃ varapradām haviṣyāśī mahādevi tataḥ siddhamanurbhavet tarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate ānīya pūjayenmantrī yathoktavidhinā śive śaktivakṣaḥsamāśliṣṭo japenmūlaṃ yathāvidhi mantrasiddhirbhavet tasya devānāmapi durlabhā

putrajanmotsavadine sūtikākulamandire bhavenmanuḥ mṛtakāśaucadivase prathame sādhako japet ekādaśe'hani sudhīḥ kuryānmantraṃ tu saṃskṛtam athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅko mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet sūryoparāgavelāyāṃ japenmantraṃ maheśvari athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate daśāṃśasaṃskṛto mantro bhaveccintāmaṇiḥ kṣaṇāt varṇalakṣapuraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ avācyaṃ guhyamīśāni gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ paṭalaḥ yaṃ labdhvā sādhako devi martyo'pyamaratāṃ labhet puraścaraṇahomasya vada me'dya vidhiṃ vibho gatvā rahaḥsthalaṃ devi homaṃ kuryād daśāṃśataḥ gṛhītvā homasaṃbhāraṃ vrajet prayatamānasaḥ aiśānyāṃ diśi deveśi likhecchrīcakramuttamam tato mantraṃ japet siddhamaṣṭottaraśatāvadhi hastaikavistṛtaṃ cādho hastaikaparimāṇataḥ ṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃ ca trivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhāṅkitam yathoktavidhinā yena sādhako dīkṣito bhavet caturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥ vartulī [g: vārtālī] vīrasūrvāmyā pūjyā aṣṭadalasthitāḥ ṣaṭkoṇamadhyagāḥ pūjyāḥ kuṇḍacakre maheśvari svāhābhagavatīṃ bindau jātavedasamarcayet

tāraṃ vahniḥ śivo'bdhiśca hṛjjaṃ śaktirmaheśvari bhāsvareti trinetreti jvālāmukha padaṃ vadet ṭhadvayaṃ saṃvadedante mantro'yaṃ vahnivallabhaḥ gandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ tatra saṃpūjya deveśi śrīcakraṃ navayonikam tato devi pramathyāgniṃ kuṇḍacakre kuleśvari agniṃ sandīpya mūlena praṇamed vahnimudrayā aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā dadyādājyena pārvati matsyaṇḍaśarkarācandraiḥ kastūrīdṛṣadaṅkitaiḥ pañca vā nava vā devi tathaikādaśa vā śive dṛḍhavratāñchubhācārān devībhaktiratāṃstathā tatra saṃpūjya vidhivaj jñātvā bhairavasannibhān tān saṃpūjya mahādevi daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret kulasādhakapūjāyāṃ saṃśayaṃ chetumarhasi athavā kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vā vada vistarāt nivṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak na puraścaraṇārcāyāṃ tatra sarve dvijottamāḥ dṛḍhavrataḥ śubhācāraḥ kulīnaḥ śivapūjakaḥ tatra homaṃ ca saṃpādya dadyānnaivedyamādarāt pūjayet kṣatriyo vīro bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ naivedyācamanīyādyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca lehyakaiḥ sādhakaḥ kṣatriyaṃ vīraṃ dātāraṃ vīrasevakam kulacakragatā virāḥ kulacakraprapūjakāḥ kṣatriyo'pi mahādevi kulasaṅghān kulārthavit iha loke śriyaṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān

evaṃ vidhāya mantrajño homaṃ japaphalāptaye varṇalakṣajapasyaivaṃ phalamāpnoti kaulikaḥ saṃhāramudrayā devīṃ visṛjya saśivāṃ śive aprakāśyamadātavyamityājñā pārameśvarī puraścaryāhomavidhinirūpaṇamekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ śrīcakranirṇayaṃ nāma paṭalaṃ devadurlabham yasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ devīnāṃ ca tathā devi trayastriṃśatikoṭayaḥ pūrvoktā yā mahādevi tāsāṃ mantrottamāñchṛṇu sarvārthasādhakaṃ devi sarvāśāparipūrakam bālādicakramidamārtiharaṃ girīśabrahmendraviṣṇunamitaṃ gaditaṃ mayā te sakalāgamasārāḍhyamāpaduddhāraṇakṣamam śrīcakraṃ te varṇitaṃ bhairavīyam sarvasaṃmonaṃ devi sarvasiddhipravartakam bhaktyābhīṣṭaphalapradaṃ kaliyuge śrīcakramuddyotate vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ sarvārthasiddhidaṃ loke sarvakāmaprapūrakam bravīmi dayayā devi sarvasārasvatapradam yatheṣṭaphaladaṃ śrībhadrakālīpriyam [kh, g: bhaiṃ] devadevi tava prītyā nacānyatra prakāśayet bhūmandiraṃ pārvati vahnirekhaṃ mātaṅginīyantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam prītyā bhaktyā maheśāni nacākhyeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ śrīcakrametad bhuvaneśvarīpriyam bhogamokṣapradaṃ devi gopyaṃ kuru maheśvari sabhūpuraṃ caikajaṭāvilāsagehaṃ mayā yantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam

pravakṣyāmi tava prītyā na vaktavyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ vasvaśrayuktaṃ dharaṇīgṛhaṃ syāt śrīcakrametat paradevatāyāḥ sumukhyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ śrīcakraṃ sumukhīpriyaṃ vijayatād bhogāpavargapradam sarasvatyāḥ kaulikānāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam mayoktaṃ hi sārasvataṃ yantrametat sarvasaṃmohanaṃ devi sarvabhogaikasādhanam dharāmandiraṃ cānnapūrṇeṣṭacakram yamabhyarcya mayā prāptaṃ durlabhaṃ paramaṃ padam śrīcakraṃ paramārthadāyi ca mahālakṣmīpriyaṃ siddhidam śārikāyā mahādevi līlālayalayākulam yantrametaduditaṃ śilālayam sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam bhūgehaṃ syācchāradāyantrametat indrākṣyāstattvasarvasvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu gopitam bhūgehabimbamanalenaśaśiprabhābhamindrākṣiṇīpriyataraṃ jayacakrametat sarvasiddhipradaṃ devi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ vṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametad bagalāmukhīyam bravīmi paramaprītyā sakalābhīṣṭasādhanam dharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ turyālayaṃ cakramidaṃ pradiṣṭam sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvasaṃmohanaṃ tathā vṛttatrayaṃ dharāsadma rājñīśrīcakramīritam sarvatattvaikanilayaṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakam jvālāmukhyā jagati jayatāccakrametanmaheśi sarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam

vṛttatrayaṃ bhūmigehatrayāḍhyaṃ bhīḍāyantraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ syāt yantroddhāraṃ parānandasādhanaikarasāyanam mūlamantrarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam vṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ syāt śrīcakramānandapadaṃ bhavānyāḥ śrīvajrayoginīdevyāḥ sarvasaukhyapravardhanam dharāgṛhaṃ yantramidaṃ maheśi śrīvajraśabdāṅkitayoginīyam sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sādhakānāṃ śubhāvaham sarvavairipraśamanaṃ sarvavāñchitapūrakam trivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ yantraṃ siddhalakṣmyā mayā smṛtam sādhakeṣṭapradaṃ divyaṃ parapadarasālayam [ṅ: rīṣṭam] sarvārthasādhakaṃ divyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam sarvadevarahasyaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ dharāgṛhaṃ sarvarahasyagarbhaṃ śrīkubjikāyantramidaṃ mayoktam sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ śive bhūmandiraṃ kaulakuleṣṭatattvabhūtaṃ sucakraṃ kathitaṃ hi gauryāḥ yogināṃ durlabhaṃ yogasādhanānandakāraṇam dharāgṛhaṃ mayākhyātaṃ khecarīyantramuttamam mahācīnapadasthānāṃ siddhidaṃ bhogadaṃ śive dharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ yantraṃ paraṃ nīlasarasvatīyam sarvasaṃpatpradaṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam bhūgṛhaṃ yantrametatte parāśaktermayā smṛtam sarvasādhāraṇaṃ sarvavāñchitaikapradāyakam śaivam sarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhapradam

gururaghoro vakṣye'haṃ tasya yantramanuttamam caturbhūgṛhodbhāsitaṃ vahnirekhaṃ sadoddyotate'ghoradevasya yantram lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭhastasya yantraṃ bravīmyaham ṣoḍaśāraṃ ravṛttaṃ ca bhūgehenopaśobhitam tattvaṃ tava mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat yantradhāraṇapūjāyā vidhiṃ sādhāraṇaṃ param na siddhiḥ sādhakasyāsti bhairavasyāpi pārvati sā vidyā koṭijaptāpi tasya niṣphalatāṃ vrajet brāhmye muhūrte utthāya snātvā dhyātvā guruṃ nijam gandhāṣṭakena vilikhed yantraṃ mūlena veṣṭitam likhet kanakalekhanyā bhūrjapatre suśobhane avācyaṃ devabhaktāya paraśiṣyāya sarvathā karpūraṃ mṛganābhiśca madyaṃ ca malayodbhavam vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śaivānāṃ śāktānāṃ ca śubhāvaham bhairavi bhairaveṣṭam] nyāsamṛṣyādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyed devīṃ śivāṅkagām mātṛkā vilikhenmantrī tadbāhye kavacaṃ likhet veṣṭayet śvetasūtreṇa pītanīlakrameṇa ca lākṣayā pariveṣṭyātha suvarṇenātha veṣṭayet yantradhāraṇa yantrasya bindau saṃsthāpayecchive kaulikānāṃ hitārthāya gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ trivṛttaṃ ca dharāsadma yantradhāraṇa yantrakam yasya pūjanamātreṇa mantrī bhairavatāṃ vrajet caturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥ karālaṃ vikarāla ca supteśonmattabhairavau

durgāṃ caṇḍīṃ ca sumukhīṃ śivādūtīṃ śivāṃ jayām tārāṃ ca tāriṇīṃ turyāṃ bagalāṃ vijayāṃ tathā bhavānī kubjikā gaurī tryaśre pūjyā maheśvari gandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ tatra bindau mahādevi yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ devatāprītaye dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ gurave'pi ca pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayet sādhakottamaḥ prāṇān dattvā''vāhanādimudrā mantrī pradarśayet cintayed devatārūpāṃ pūjayed yantrarājavat mūlamantraṃ yathāśaktyā mālayā karamālayā stotraṃ mantramayaṃ devi mantricakraṃ [g: mantra] prapūjayet tān santarpya sudhīrbhaktyā dhārayed devatāṃ hṛdi dhārayenmūrdhnī vā bāhau guṭikāṃ varadāyinīm sākṣād bhavabhayonmukto bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ bahunoktena kiṃ devi sa bhaved bhairavaḥ svayam sārāt sārataraṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ paṭalaḥ tathā devīśvarādīnāṃ devatābījanirṇayam devīnāmādidevānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ me rahasyakam devānāṃ mantrarājasya devīnāṃ vā tathaiva ca tathābdaṣaṣṭilakṣāṇi ṣaṣṭijanmāntareṣu ca ṛṣihīno bhavenmantro japto janmāntareṣu ca yadā mantro mayā vaktrānmahādevi bahiṣkṛtaḥ chandāṃsi vividhānyeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ parameśvari yadā japto manurdevi mayā paramabhaktitaḥ

mantrarājasya devīnāṃ [kh: devānāṃ] yenotpattirmayā kṛtā bījahīno bhavenmantraḥ siddhihānikaraḥ śive japānte jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārikī matiḥ śaktihīno mahādevi mantro vighnakaro mataḥ japtvā stutvā mahādevi punaryena sa gopitaḥ niṣkīlitaṃ japānte ca manumaśraddhayā śive japakāle mahādevi rākṣasā bhūtapretakāḥ digbandhena [kh: bandhane] vinā devi japaḥ pāṭho'pi vā tathā etairvihīno mantro'sti niṣphalo vighnakārakaḥ gopanīyo mahāvīrairityājñā pārameśvarī yena sādhanamātreṇa sādhako bhairavo bhavet vismṛto'yaṃ vidhirguhyaḥ śmaśānasyārcanāṅkitaḥ nāmabhirviśrutā devi bhavatyā me paraṃ śrutāḥ sādhakā yena jāyante sarvasiddhiyutāḥ śive na siddhyanti varārohe kalau bhairavaśāpataḥ tatra gatvārcayed yastu sa bhaved bhairavopamaḥ sārameyaiśca yakṣendraiḥ soragaiḥ sapiśācakaiḥ tatra bhūtā mahāghorāścatvāro vighnakārakāḥ te saṃmukhagatāḥ krūrā bhūtāḥ kurvanti vipriyam teṣāṃ vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyaṃ sārottamottamam ravau candre kuje saumye gurau śukre śanau tathā mahogra citrāṅgada caṇḍa bhāsvallolākṣa bhūteśa karāla bhīmāḥ etān samabhyarcya vaset śmaśāne syādanyathā dhībhramaṇaṃ vipattiḥ pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ gadyapadyamayīṃ devi mantrasiddhipradāyinīm

śmaśānārcanasaṃbhāraṃ samādāya ca sānugaḥ tatra devi vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārvati sādaram guhyaṃ sāratamaṃ gopyaṃ nākhyeyaṃ siddhivāñchakaiḥ prāṇiprāṇālayodbhūte cite me'nugrahaṃ kuru kathaṃ saṃdhārayen mantrī tatra saṃmukhapṛṣṭhayoḥ vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ durātmane eva vāyau karālako nirṛtigo'pi mande ravau punaḥ paścimago'pi bhīmaḥ sudhāṃśuvṛddhau śaśihīnapakṣe tadvaiparītyena śive bhramanti kathaṃ devi kariṣyanti dvayorbhāskaravārayoḥ ravivāraṃ ca saṃguṇya prathamaṃ vā dvitīyakam dvitīye paścime bhīmaṃ pūjayecchuklapakṣake adhunaiṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjāsāraṃ maheśvari śmaśānapūjāmantrasya mahākāla ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ parā bījaṃ taṭaṃ śaktiḥ kālī kīlakamīritam surāpānavidhiṃ brūhi yena siddhirbhaved dhruvam sādhakā yena jāyante kalau bhairavasannibhāḥ vinā pānaṃ na siddhiḥ syāt sādhakānāṃ kalau dhruvam teṣu brahmādayo devā nilīnā muktaye param tatra sarve sthitā devā vāsavādyā aharniśam tatra pānaṃ parādevyā mahānandapradāyakam na siddhyati śive mantraḥ śmaśānārcāṃ vinā tathā pānaṃ bhajet parādevyāḥ śrīcakrāgre yathāvidhi ahorātre surāpānaṃ bhogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śive sa vaiṣṇavaḥ sa śāktaśca sa śaivo yaḥ śmaśānagaḥ

pānaṃ tāvadbhajed devi yāvat saṃvinmanomayī yāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥ vinā pūjāṃ caredyastu pānaṃ vā carvaṇādikam sa rogī [sa bhogī iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ] nindito loke parapiṇḍopajīvakaḥ ātmocchiṣṭaṃ na dātavyaṃ parocchiṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet siddhihānirbhavet sadyo yoginyo bhakṣayanti tam abhyarcya vidhinā pānaṃ kṛtvā carvaṇapūrvakam pānaṃ pānaṃ śive pānaṃ saptavāraṃ samuccaret ityeṣā paddhatirguhyā śmaśānārcanasaṃyutā tava snehena vikhyātā na prakāśyā kadācana aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat paṭalaḥ śrīdevyā yantrarājasya mālākaṅkaṇayorapi yena śuddhirbhaved deva dravyāṇāṃ sādhakasya hi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke paṭalaṃ guhyamuttamam kapālaṃ naradantānāṃ mālā kaṅkaṇamīśvari punaraṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tenaiva tarpayet śmaśānabhasmaliptena śuddhena suravandite mālāṃ kuryānnṛdantānāṃ sakalābhīṣṭasiddhaye yantraṃ mālāṃ śive tasya mantrahānirbhaved dhruvam śmaśānabhasma śuddhaṃ ca kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥ kapālayantraṃ deveśi keśakaṅkaṇamuttamam gopayet sādhako'tyantaṃ devīrūpaṃ vicintayet anyathā siddhihāniḥ syānmamāpi parameśvari aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ

paṭalaḥ śodhanaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistarāt paramārthadam śodhanasya hi dravyāṇāṃ mālādīnāṃ maheśvari kaṅkaṇaṃ dantamālāṃ ca yantraṃ kāpālikaṃ śive makārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayed bhairaveśvarīm pañcagavyamiti prājyaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ pūtāsamevaṃ malayodbhavaṃ ca sadyantraśuddhau mahadauṣadhāni yantre devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ vāmācāraḥ [g, gh: kaulā] paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ yadi tatra vikāraḥ syāt pānaṃ tad brahmaghātavat retasā tarpayed devīṃ śaktiṃ pānena tarpayet makārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ kuryācchrīcakramaṇḍalam santarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ miṣṭānnaiścarvaṇaiḥ śive santoṣayitvā svaguruṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ sakalāgamasārāḍhyāṃ gopayet sādhakottamaḥ paṭalaḥ yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāt tatrotpannā surādevī kumārīrūpadhāriṇī aṣṭādaśabhujā divyā navakumbhadharā tathā nānākusumabhūṣāḍhyā muktakeśī trilocanā raktātnāṅgulīyaśobhāḍhyā tuṅgāpīnastanāñcitā ratnasiṃhāsanagatā paramānandadāyinī sasurāsuragandharvāḥ seśvarāḥ sasadāśivāḥ ādau pātraṃ dadau divyamānandarasapūritam pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātā guḍalatāstataḥ

ikṣubhedāśca khadirāstryūṣaṇādyāḥ sitādayaḥ gauḍī caitadyutā proktā sarvārthaphaladāyinī pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ tato jātāhivallarī mṛdvīkādyā mahādevi jātāḥ paramapāvanāḥ tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ rudrāyāmṛtapūritam tatkaṇebhyo bhadantī ca jātā vai dhānyajātayaḥ tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave tatkaṇebhyo'pi deveśi tadbhedāḥ kanakādayaḥ vijayeti mayā proktā vaiṣṇavī paramārthadā tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śrīsurā parameṣṭhine tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāḥ kṣaudrarasādayaḥ pūritaṃ] tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāścāmalakādayaḥ tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ gurave girije surā jātaṃ tatkaṇajā bhedā nārikelaphalādayaḥ tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śukrāyāmṛtapūritam bhādhāmakādayaḥ] tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā vividhauṣadhayaḥ śive sarvārthaphaladaṃ devi sarvasārasvatapradam te sarve parameśāni surānandaikanirbharāḥ ye pibanti paraṃ pānaṃ paramānandakāraṇam vinā gauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ surāṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivām adīkṣitaḥ paśurdevi dīkṣito'pyasuraḥ paśuḥ pivedgauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ paiṣṭīmāsavamuttamam ānandeśvarasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat

tatkālaṃ yadvadānandapātraṃ devaiśca vanditam guruṇā dattamabhyarcya praṇamecchirasā tadā dvitīyamadhunānandaikasaṃvardhanam vande pātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamam surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ [gh: sevitaṃ] srīmadbhairavabhairavīpriyataraṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ numaḥ mām pātraṃ lakṣaguṇātmakaṃ ca navamaṃ prauḍhapratāpaṃ bhaje durlabhaṃ pāvanaṃ pātraṃ daśamaṃ praṇamāmyaham pātramekādaśaṃ vande gurusevāsukhāgatam iha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā dehānte bhairavo bhavet pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum [k: samaṃ mākṣikam] hṛdaye tripurā bālā yāgaśālā gṛhe gṛhe yogināmapyagamyaḥ śivo'ham bhaktirgurupadāmbhoje śaraṇaṃ [kh: smaraṇaṃ] kimataḥ param sāgareṇa surasaṃ te bhuktimuktī gatāḥ punarutthāya vai pītvā punarjanma na vidyate suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham tāvat pānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ param paṭalaḥ vīrā yena parānandapadaṃ prāpsyanti niḥspṛhāḥ namāmi śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyam namaḥ śrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhapradāyine

kāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥ bhagavān kuleśaḥ viśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā ye ṣaḍyoginīpravaravīrakulaprasūtā nandantu bhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥ śāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥ ripubhakṣaṇodyamaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥ kulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāntiṃ prayacchantu me prityā devyaḥ sadā vaḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu virendravandyāḥ yogīśāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpuruṣamunisurāścakragāḥ pāntu sarve santyatrāpi ca kaulikāśca yadi cet syānme jayaḥ sarvadā yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ kālāgnyādiśivāntaṃ ca jagadyajñena tṛpyatu samuddhṛtakleśamahoragebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ sarvaprajābhyuddharaṇodyatebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ jarārujāmṛtyunivārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ sarvatra saṃpūrṇamanorathebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ sarvārthacaryāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ prajñāpratijñāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ vistīrṇasarvārthaguṇākarebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ parasparānugrahakārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ samastasaubhāgyakalākarebhyo namo namaḥ kāraṇanāyakebhyaḥ śrīvīracaryācaraṇakṣamebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ advaitatattvāmṛtabhājanebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ prataptacāmīkaravigrahebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ mahākṛpāveṣṭitamānasebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ

svātantryavidhvastajagattamobhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ parasparājñāparipālakebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ navīnakāntārata tatparebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ svādhīnatānyakkṛtanirjarebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ nirastaniḥśeṣavikalpanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ śrīsaccidānanditavigrahebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ śivo'hamityāśritacetanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ jagajjanitavistāraṃ brahmedamiti vedmyaham matprāṇe sa tu maccātmā līnaḥ samarasīgataḥ śivādvayaprakāśāḍhyaṃ śyāmalaṃ dhāma dhīmahi saṃsārakāntāramahārṇave'sminnimajjamānaṃ jagaduddhareyam nirūpaṇamekaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ yaṃ vidhāya kalau mantrī bhavitā muktibhājanam śuddhaistaireva pūjāyāṃ bhavedbhogāpavargabhāk tadā sarve surā devi brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ asurā rākṣasā yakṣā gandharvā mānavādayaḥ kālena kalaśasthābhūt surādevī sureśvari śaptā śukreṇa deveśi kacakāraṇahatyayā brahmarṣayaḥ surādevyai daduḥ śāpaṃ yathākramam surā śaptā yadā devaistadā daityā mudaṃ yayuḥ svargānnirākṛtā devi purandarapuraḥsarāḥ sadāśivādayo devi prādurbhūtā makhottame taṃ tavāśu prayacchāmo gacchāmo nilayaṃ svakam tṛṇāgrabindumātreṇa surāyāḥ prāśitena ca

sā śaptā brahmaṇā devī viṣṇunā śaṅkareṇa ca tadā sarve surā devaṃ śivamīśvaramavyayam ekākṣarāya rudrāya akārāyātmarūpiṇe tṛtīyāya makārāya śivāya paramātmane namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase śivāya kṣitirūpāya sadāsurabhaye [gh: bhide] namaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye caiva pāvakāmitatejase mahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo namaḥ iti stutvā paraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ śivamīśvaram tadā vāgudabhūd vyomnaḥ pañcavyomaśarīriṇām yuktyānayā prasaṅgena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ atharvāhaṃ ca mantrātmā paramātmā śivo'vyayaḥ kurukullāṃ mahāvidyāṃ sadāśiva prakāśaya tasmin surādiśuddhiṃ tu prakāśaya manūttamaiḥ sadāśivaṃ maheśānaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥ namo devādidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ vedaśāstrārthagamyāya śāśvatāya namo namaḥ namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya namaḥ sāhasrikāṅghraye iti stutvā mahādevo mahātmā śrīsadāśivaḥ devadevīti yā devī yā bhavānīti viśrutā vada devāgamaṃ śāstraṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam makārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śodhanaṃ siddhivardhanam vedārthāgamatattvajñaiḥ surā sevyā mumukṣubhiḥ śāstrāṇāṃ parameśāni bhrāntiḥ kāryā na kaulikaiḥ yena śodhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate

kuṅkumenāṣṭagandhena sarvathā vīrabhasmanā sāmānyārghyodakenāśu saṃprokṣya kulasundari vahneḥ kalāḥ samabhyarcya yathāvadvarṇyate mayā daśakalātmane viśvamiti mantreṇa pūjayet jvālā haimavatī kavyavāhanī havyavāhanī pūjayitvoktavidhinā gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ haimaṃ vā rājataṃ mārdaṃ sthāpayed vīramudrayā brahmaṇā ca yathā pūrvaṃ tathā tvāṃ sthāpayāmyaham sūryanāma samuccārya jīvamantraṃ maheśvari viśvamante prayoktavyaṃ manunānena pūjayet tapinī tāpinī caiva bodhinī caiva rodhinī māyā viśvāvatī hemaprabhā saurakalā imāḥ surayā pūrayet kumbhaṃ vilomairmātṛkākṣaraiḥ candramaṇḍalamabhyarcya mantreṇānena pārvati viśvāñcalāya deveśi śrīṣoḍaśakalātmane amṛtā mānadā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ prītī ratistathā chāyā ca pūrṇimā nityā cāmāvasyā ca ṣoḍaśī mūlena tatra kalaśe trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayet praṇavenārcayed devi śivaṃ gandhena vāyunā paramākāśaśūnyaṃ ca vāhinīti samuddharet ṭhadvayāntāmimāṃ vidyāṃ japettu daśadhā ghaṭe ākṛṣṇena rajaseti nāmnīṃ paramapāvanīm tatrānandeśagāyatrīṃ japettu daśadhā priye vidmahe śrīsurādevyai dhīmahīti tato vadet gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japtvā haṃsaḥ śuciṣadārcayet

vakāraṃ dīrghaṣaṭkādyaṃ proccārya tadanantaram daśadhā prajapedvidyāmiṣe tvorjetyṛcaṃ japet śukraśāpaṃ mocaya dvirvanāntaṃ ca manuṃ japet śukraśāpaharīṃ vidyāṃ prajapeducyate yathā [kh: mayā] amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām tena satyena deveśi brahmahatyā vyapohatu kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham vimuktā rudraśāpena pavitrā bhava sāṃpratam śanno devīriti ṛcaṃ daśadhā prajaped ghaṭe churikākāriṇyuccārya śobhinīti tato vadet churikākhyāṃ japedvidyāṃ daśadhā kalaśopari guruṃ dhyātvā sahasrāre hṛtpadme'pīṣṭadevatām nīlatoyadasaṅkāśāṃ nīlakuntalaśobhitām nīlapuṣpavibhūṣāḍhyāṃ nīlālaṅkārabhūṣitām indranīlanibaddhāṃśumahārghamaṇibūṣitām nidrāpaṭena nīlena bhuvanāni caturdaśa vīrapānaratān vīrān pālayantīṃ samantataḥ paramānandavapuṣīṃ paramānandabhairavīm iti dhyātvā japedvidyāṃ yathāvad varṇyate mayā sakalajanaṃ proccārya vāgvādini tato vadet cakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇādīni ceti tiraskuru śrītiraskaraṇīṃ vidyāṃ sañjaped daśadhā ghaṭe pāvamānyaṃ paraṃ brahma pāvamānyaḥ paro rasaḥ iti japtvā guruṃ dhyātvā japed varuṇabījakam prasuptabhujagākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayāṃ śubhām

vahnikoṭidurāda(dha)rṣāṃ bisatantutanīyasīm sahasrārasthitaṃ devaṃ natvā śivapade layet amṛtaṃ vāmanāsāgrānniḥsārya kalaśe kṣipet māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmakalāmamṛte'pyamṛtodbhave aṃāṃ viṣṇukalānte ca paṭhet pārvati kaulikaḥ dhyātvāmṛtamayaṃ dravyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam vidhāya mūlamantreṇa tīrthānyāvāhayed ghaṭe gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati ityāvāhya mahādevi mudrayāṅkuśarūpayā dravyamadhye binduyutaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayet sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam amṛtārṇavamadhyasthaṃ brahmapadmoparisthitam kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamaruvādinam khaḍgakheṭakapaṭṭīśa mudgarocchūlakuntinam lohitaṃ devadeveśaṃ bhāvayet sādhakottamaḥ hakāraṃ ca bhṛguṃ devaṃ maṇḍūkaṃ dharaṇiṃ tataḥ vāyuṃ keśaṃ tathānandabhairavāya tato'ñcale ānandabhairavīṃ dhyāyed yathāvad varṇyate [g: varṇitā] śive tatrotpannā surā devī kumārīrūpadhāriṇī himakundendudhavalāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trilocanām prahasantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ devadevasya sammukhīm meghaṃ vahniṃ samīrārṇaṃ keśaṃ caiva samuddharet bhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ caiva yaṣṭvā pārvati kaulikaḥ baddhvā ca lelihānākhyāṃ mudrāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ punaḥ dvādaśāntaṃ samāsthāpya sohaṃ haṃsa iti smaret

tadudbhūtāmṛtavṛṣṭimutsṛjed vāmanāsayā sākṣādamṛtatattvāḍhyaṃ dhyāyet kalaśamuttamam daśadhā prajaped devi gandhākṣatapuraḥsaraiḥ saṃpūjya kalaśaṃ divyaṃ ghaṇṭāniḥsvānapūrvakam prapūjtha parayā bhaktyā praṇāmaiḥ stutipūrvakaiḥ yā surā sā umādevī yo dravyaṃ sa maheśvaraḥ svāde ca saṃsthitaḥ somaṃ phenāyāmanalaḥ sthitaḥ drāve gaṅgā sthitā devi ghaṭasthāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ sarvaśāpavinirmuktaṃ sarvamantrasusaṃskṛtam māheśvarairmahāvīrairmahācīnapadasthitaiḥ santarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ yoginīgaṇamaiśvaram mātṝrmātṛgaṇān sarvān bhūtapretādisaṃyutān guruṃ dhyātvā parāṃ dhyāyedvīrān saṃpūjya śaktitaḥ śaktihīne vṛthāpānaṃ śivahīne vṛthārcanam itīdaṃ śodhanaṃ divyaṃ surāyāṃ suradurlabham madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā mīno mudrā maithunameva ca pūjāyāṃ yadyadānītaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyakam vinābhimantraṇenaitad yo mohād bhakṣayecchive caturasraṃ likhedbimbaṃ tatra mīnān nidhāpayet vāyubījena vāhnyena vāruṇena yathākramam daśadhā prajapenmantramānandeśvarabhairavam kṛtāvatāro hariṇā kalinā pīḍitaṃ jagat bhairavīparitoṣārthaṃ svayaṃ mīno'bhavad hariḥ tryambakaṃ yajāmahīti mantraṃ triḥsañjapet sudhīḥ caturasre mahādevi māṃsapātraṃ nidhāpayet

mudrātrayaṃ pradarśyāśu prapaṭhet kauliko manum balyarthaṃ śivaśaktyostaṃ prapadye viṣṇumavyayam triḥ paṭhitvā ṛcaṃ devi japet kaulikasattamaḥ mudrāpātraṃ samānīya sthāpayeccaturaśrake mudrātrayaṃ ca saṃdarśya prapaṭhed vedavad vidhim balyarthaṃ devadevyośca pavitrāṇīha siddhaye (tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ prajapyopari kaulikaḥ caturaśre ca saṃsthāpya śoṣayed dāhayet sudhīḥ mūlaṃ ca daśadhā japtvā japedṛcamathopari sarveṣu devadravyeṣu samānīteṣu kaulikaiḥ glūṃmlūṃslūṃplūṃnlūṃ deveśi svāntaṃ khaṃ kāmakālikam srāvaya dvayamuddhṛtya ṭhadvayaṃ ca samuddharet pañcānāṃ pañcakalpānāṃ smaraṇīyārcanāvidhau ṛgbhiḥ krameṇa mūlena plā(pā)vayecca yathākramam evaṃ saṃśodhya dravyāṇi paramāṇi kuleśvari ayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā devatārcanam evaṃ saṃskṛtya deveśi gurubhaktipuraḥsaram itīdaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyānāṃ rahasyakam paṭalaḥ yena [g: yasya] śravaṇamātreṇa parāśaktipade layet tatkathāśravaṇaṃ cet syāt tattalpagamanaṃ yadi sa kulīnaḥ kathaṃ deva pūjayet kulayoṣitam kṛte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikā ratikāle maheśānī dīkṣākāle ca kanyakā surayā retasā vāpi jalena madhunātha vā

svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā rūpayauvanagarvitām kulayogī kathaṃ kuryācchodhanaṃ kulayoṣitām vidhāya mānasīṃ pūjāṃ mantraṃ yogī samuccaret kutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtya vibhāvayet sarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā siddhirodhakṛt strīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamanyathā svastriyāmapi sādhakasya bhavedāśu kāmadhenurivāparā tatparaḥ paratanvīnāṃ paratattve pralīyate brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā etāsu kāṃcidānīya saṃśodhanamathācaret śaktiśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ sadāśivaḥ vāgbījaṃ bījamīśāni śaktiḥ śaktiritīritā bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogo maheśvari ekādaśa navāṣṭau vā kaulikaḥ kaulikeśvari sādhakaḥ saṃspṛśedādau kṛtvā viṣṭaraśodhanam mantrasaṃkalpakaṃ kṛtvā munyādinyāsamācaret hṛtpīṭhārcāṃ vidhāyātha [ṅ: yātra] śrīcakrārcanamācaret vīrārcanaṃ vīrakāntāsevanaṃ devadurlabham śaktiṃ vāme tu saṃsthāpya pūjayedvarṇyate yathā śivatryaśraṃ kāmatryaśraṃ hetitryaśraṃ maheśvari śrīcakreṣu hi naṭyādimālinyantaṃ vicārya ca tadīyaṃ yantramālikhya tasmiṃstāmeva pūjayet muktakeśīṃ vītalajjāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ānandalīnahṛdayāṃ saundaryātimanoharām bālābījatrayaṃ devi proccārya tadanantaraṃ

imāṃ śaktiṃ pavitrīti kuru yugmaṃ samuddharet mantreṇānena deveśi kāminīmabhiṣecayet mātṛkāvanmahādevi kāmabāṇāṃstato nyaset śaktibījaṃ tato devi yathāvadvinyaset priye sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ bāṇaṃ sarvavidrāvaṇaṃ tathā vaśikaraṇabāṇaṃ ca pañceṣoḥ pañcabāṇakān varṇyate mayā] naṭinīti mahāsiddhiṃ mama dehi yugaṃ vadet kālīṃ kūrcaṃ parāṃ śaktiṃ kāmaṃ kāpālini priye devi kāpālikīmantraḥ kāmadevavaśaṅkaraḥ veśye kāmadughe reto muñca yugmāgnivallabhā vedādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ kāmaṃ śaktiṃ lakṣmīṃ parāṃ smaret rajakīśuddhimantro'yaṃ kulayoṣidvaśaṅkaraḥ hara yugmaṃ ca me vighnāṃsturagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ tataḥ vedādyaṃ bhūtibījaṃ ca tāraṃ māyāṃ dhanurdharaḥ siddhiṃ me dehi dehīti haraṃ dahanavallabhā tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ śūdrāṇi ca ratapriye śūdrāṇīśuddhimantro'yaṃ kāminījanamohanaḥ gopāli me siddhadaṇḍaṃ drāvaya dvayamuddharet tāradvayīsaṃpuṭitāṃ mṛdvīkāṃ dīrghasaṃyutām turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ prānte mantro'yaṃ mālinīpriyaḥ yonau japet kumārīṇāṃ kaulikaḥ karamālayā adīkṣitāpi deveśi kīkṣitaiva bhavet tadā tāraṃ vyoṣamauṣmakaṃ ca śivāyeti svayambhuvam karituṇḍākhyamudrayā]

ratena tarpayet tatra śrīcakre vīrasaṃsadi dharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucā svāhāntamantramuccārya japan mūlaṃ smaran parām ratānte sañjapenmūlaṃ paṭhenmantramimaṃ punaḥ prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam svāhāntenāśu mantreṇa śukramādāya pārvati saṃpūjya kāntāṃ santarpya stutvā natvā parasparam itīdaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ śaktiśodhanamuttamam trayorviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ yena śodhanamātreṇa mālā siddhyati satphalā kiyatphalā kiyatsaṃkhyā sarvaṃ me vaktumarhasi mālā japasya deveśi rahasyamidamaiśvaram dvādaśātmā sa savitā tadantāvṛttirīritā āvartayecca navadhā tāmeva japasiddhaye mālārahasyasarvasvaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit kṛtvā meruṃ mahārudraṃ japamālā vinirmitā anyathā japahāniḥ syādrudrasya vacanaṃ yathā pāyuṃ pāyau nibadhnīyāt sūtre mantramanusmaran śaṅkhamuktāpravālārka rudrākṣavaravīrudhām sarveṣāṃ golakānāṃ ca meruṃ rudrākṣamācaret ṣaṇmāsenākṣasūtrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ sādhakaścaret ṣaṭtriṃśattattvagolakān aṣṭotkṛṣṭaśate prauḍhā māleyaṃ devi durlabhā varṇitā mātṛkāmālā vedādihavirāśritā tāradvayaṃ ca vargānte varṇādyante ca taddvayam

tārakāmaiḥ saṃpuṭitā māleyaṃ guruvallabhā ṣaḍānanodbhavāstārāḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍāmnāyasūcakāḥ rudrākṣāṇāṃ prakurvīta mālāṃ sarvārthasiddhidām pūrvāmnāyādibhedānāṃ mālāṃ kuryādyathākramam tārakāmena saṃyojya brahmotkṛṣṭaśataṃ śive svaravargayaśāṁllāntān yojayet parameśvari śrīmahāṣoḍaśīvidyāgurūnādāya pārvati śivāmāleyamākhyātā śivasāyujyasiddhaye tryadhikairyojayenmālā bhairavīyamudāhṛtā anāmikādvayaṃ parva kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa tu kaniṣṭhikācatuṣparvānāmāparvatrayaṃ tathā saṃyojya saṃjaped vidyāṃ mantrī dvādaśaparvasu durgāvṛttyā japed devi sahasrādyayutāvadhi pralambaparvatritaye trayo devāḥ samāhitāḥ kulikaśceti vikhyāto japahānikaro mataḥ kaniṣṭhāmūlaparvādikrameṇa karagāḥ surāḥ īśāno'gnirnir-ṛtiśca vāyurindro yamastathā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ mudgarollaṅghane śaktirmahārudrasya kevalam anyathā devi mantrī ca devatāśāpamāpnuyāt yayā siddhirbhaved devi devānāmapi durlabhā vidhāya bhasmanā snānaṃ jalena mantritena vā bhūtaśuddhikramopetaṃ prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ tataḥ mālāśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ kālāgnirudrakaḥ kālarātrīti vikhyātā muṇḍamālāvilāsinī

sūryākhyaṃ kīlakaṃ mālāśuddhaye viniyogakaḥ aṅganyāsaṃ vidhāyātha karanyāsādipūrvakam prāṇān devi pratiṣṭhāpya śrīcakrārcanamācaret kṣetreśa yoginīvṛndaṃ santarpya kulasundari mālāyā devadeveśi yathāmnāyaṃ yathāvidhi mālāmūleṇa deveśi mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ śaṅkhinīti padaṃ vadet tāraṃ lajjā yugaṃ tāraṃ muktāmālini mā yugam tāraṃ vadhūṃ ca vedādyaṃ raudre ca rodhramālini tāraṃ mātrādyamuccārya sūryākhyabīja yugmakam tāramabdhiramāmāyāḥ sindhuṃ rudrākṣamālini tāraṃ tārātrayaṃ tāraṃ vadhūṃ tulasi vaiṣṇavi vedādyaṃ kamalā kuntī vāgbījaṃ kāmaśaktikam tāraṃ ca vāyupūjyā ca tāraṃ padmākṣamālini tāratrayaṃ mā trayaṃ ca kāmarājatrayaṃ śive vadhūrvastraṃ vanaṃ mantro naradantaviśuddhikṛt mālāṃ saṃśodhya saṃpūjya mūlaṃ japtvā daśāṃśataḥ ṅ: parāśakti] svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvamālāviśodhanaḥ me ṭhadvayaṃ mahāmantraḥ sadā [g: sarva] mālāviśodhanaḥ mālāmādāya deveśi sañjapedardharātrake vada deva kathaṃ kuryāt kaulikaḥ sarvasiddhaye mantro'yaṃ karamālāyāḥ śuddhidaḥ [g: kṛt] sarvasiddhidaḥ tato japenmahāvidyāṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ

caturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kaulikānāṃ hitāya ca kāpālikaṃ ca pāśāsaṃ śrīcakraṃ vaiṣṇavāśmikam vibhāvayenmahāyantraṃ daivaṃ bhaumaṃ ca bhāvikam siddhasādhyakam pañcame pañcame devi tataḥ siddhipradaṃ bhavet caturthe ca caturthe ca tataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt rājataṃ tāmrikaṃ yantraṃ ṣaṇmāsānte ca śodhayet siddhaye kauliko devi yathāvadvarṇyate mayā triṣṭup chanda iti khyātaṃ parāśaktiśca devatā śrīcakraśuddhisiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ tato viṣṭaraśuddhiṃ ca prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caret vidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ layāṅganyāsasaṃyutam mūlatrikhaṇḍakaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā prāṇacayaṃ śive svarṇasiṃhāsane sthāpya śrīcakraṃ sveṣṭadaivatam aṣṭagandhena vā devi pauruṣeṇa rasena vā śrīcakraṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjayet tatra kaulikaḥ yantraṃ sauvarṇamuddhṛtya śodhaya dvayamuddharet tāraṃ sindhuṃ ca tāraṃ ca rājataṃ yantramuddharet tāraṃ tārā ca tāraṃ ca vadhūṃ tāraṃ ca tārakā vedādyaṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ tāraṃ yantraṃ kulāmbike praṇavaṃ kūvarībījaṃ mā māyā vāyupūjitā tāraṃ vāk kāmarājaśca śaktiḥ kapālamālini tāraṃ gaurī ca tārtīyaṃ vāk kāmaśca citāsane vedādyaṃ haritaṃ vāṇī śaktiḥ kāmo ramā ramā

ityevaṃ yantramīśāni ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam ṅ: puṣpakaiḥ] yathoktāṃ sādhakaḥ kuryād dravyaśodhanapūrvakam niśīthakālaṃ me brūhi saṃśayo'yaṃ mahān mama niśītho vārdharātraśca tṛtīyaiva mahāniśā muhūrte dve samādāya tathā dve ca maheśvari ardharātro muhūrte dve pūjārhaḥ parameśvari yāmadvayādardharātro varṇitaḥ kaulasiddhaye tasyāṃ parāṃ japedyastu sa bhavecchivasannibhaḥ mahāniśāyāṃ prajapet parāṃ kaulikasattamaḥ rajaḥ śukraṃ surāṃ devi māṃsaṃ mīnaṃ ca maithunam pibenmadyaṃ bhajedrāmāṃ smared bhairavibhairavam prātaḥkṛtyaṃ śive kṛtvā śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tataḥ parāṃ japet sadā satyāṃ tato yāti paraṃ padam mahāmohe mahā'saukhye mahādāridryasaṅkaṭe durāpadi durāśe ca durbhikṣe durnimittake vaktre sarasvatī tasya lakṣmīstasya gṛhe sadā [kh: tathā] mayoditaṃ tava snehānnākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ kuleśa śrotumicchāmi tantrasyāsyottarārdhakam tantrottarārdhaṃ vakṣyāmi rahasyavijayābhidham devadevīti yā khyātā [k: vikhyātā] gāyatrīti śrutau smṛtā pañcātmikā pañcamīśī pañcavyomaprakāśini parādevīti yā durgā sā śivaḥ sā hariḥ smṛtā pañcamī pañcikā devī pañcamācāravartinī

pañcakṛtyamayī [k, kh, g: vedya] devī sarvadevīmayī śivā mahāśyāmā mahāvidyā pūjanīyā yathākramam gaṇeśārkaharīśāna durgāṇāṃ paramārthavit devīcakre'rcayet sarvāṃśchivaliṅge'thavā śive śrīgaṇeśvaracakreṇa ma bhedaṃ kārayed budhaḥ pṛthak pṛthak śive kuryādarcanaṃ kaulikottamaḥ śrīdevyā ugradurgāyā mantrī devīrahasyavit [k: vat] rahasyavijayaṃ nāma tantraṃ tantrottarārdhakam gaṇeśasya ca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ savitustathā durgādevyāśca pañcāṅgaṃ durgādevīrahasyakam sarvasvametad deveśi tantraṃ devīrahasyakam prathamaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ śṛṇu merupṛṣṭhe sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ trilocanam siddhakinnaragandharvairyakṣabhūtapiśācakaiḥ sasmitaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ ca brahmaṇā hariṇā saha kāryasya devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca avaktavyamabhaktebhyo bhaktebhyo muktisādhanam vighnakartā jagattrātā vighnaharteti viśrutaḥ vighno na bādhate jātu [k: tasya] yastaṃ saṃpūjayet sadā paṭhennāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu stotraṃ mūlaikasādhanam mantraṃ yantraṃ stavaṃ varma nāmnāṃ sahasramuttamam gajānano gaṇādhyakṣo vināyaka iti śrutaḥ tatrādau te pravakṣyāmi mantroddhāraṃ sureśvari hyaṣṭāviṃśativarṇako nigadito vaināyako'yaṃ manuḥ vaṭe catuṣpathe śūnyagṛhe pretālaye caret

na kleśo naca durbuddhirna moho naca śokatā yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāparipūrakam suvṛttaṃ caturdvārayuktaṃ prayuktaṃ gajāsyasya śrīcakrametat prasiddham yena smaraṇamātreṇa sarvo vighnaḥ palāyate dhyāyet siṃhayugāsanaṃ gaṇapatiṃ trailokyacintāmaṇim ṣaḍvargabījabhāgena kalyanyāsaṃ caret tataḥ pūjanaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitaṃ śarajanmanā pūrvapaścimayoḥ pūjyā dakṣiṇottarayostathā puṣpadantavikartāntya cittalohitasundarāḥ gaṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa saṃpūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśāreṣu sundari mahākālaṃ ca kālāgniṃ sitāsyamasitātmakam vināyakaṃ vighnarājaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gajānanam ekadantaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ daśāreṣu prapūjayet trikoṇe pūjayedbindau mahāgaṇapatiṃ prabhum vighnāntakākhuvāhau ca tripurāntakamīśvari śatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ dantamālāṃ maheśvari śaṅkhau saṃpūjayedbindau layāṅgamidamucyate gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devo gaṇapatiḥ smṛtaḥ kurudvayaṃ kīlakaṃ syāt sarvamantraikasādhanam ayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ hutvā sarpiryavāṅkuram ayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ vaṭe hutvā citānale nadyāṃ sādhaka evāśu japedayutasaṃkhyayā vidveṣayecca brahmāṇaṃ girije nātra saṃśayaḥ vaśayedapi rājānamākarṣayati yoṣitaḥ sarvatantraikasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ

gadyaikasārasarvasvāmānandaikataraṅgiṇīm mahāgaṇapaterdivyāṃ sarvathā devi gopayet saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ kavacaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vajrapañjarakābhidham kāruṇyenāntarāyāmitabhayaśamanaṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmi vināyako lalāṭaṃ me vighnarājo bhruvau mama śrutī me'vatu herambo gaṇḍau me modakāśanaḥ dantān mamaikadanto'vyād vakratuṇḍao'vatād rasām vighnāntako bhujau pātu hastau mūṣakavāhanaḥ hṛdayaṃ me kumāro'vyājjayantaḥ pārśvayugmakam kaṭiṃ nandigaṇaḥ pātu śiśnaṃ vīreśvaro'vatu virāṭako'vatādūrū jānū me puṣpadantakaḥ pādau cittagaṇaḥ pātu pādādho lohito'vatu vicāro jaṭharaṃ pātu bhūtāni cograrūpakaḥ pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ vapuḥ pātu vinartakaḥ pūrve māṃ hrīṃ karālo'vyādāgneye vikarālakaḥ paścime māṃ māhākālo vāyau kālāgnibhairavaḥ prabhāte śatapatro'vyāt sahasrārastu madhyame kalaśo māṃ niśīthe'vyānniśānte paraśustathā nityaṃ yakṣapiśācabhūtaphaṇiṣu glauṃgaṃ gaṇeśo'vatu vajrapañjaranāmānaṃ gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ vinānena na siddhiḥ syāt pūjanasya japasya ca tasya siddhirmahādevi karasthā pāralaukikī ardharātre paṭhennityaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalaṃ labhet sarvasiddhimayaṃ divyaṃ [ṅ: pūjya] gopayet parameśvari

mahāgaṇapatikavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ tava bhaktyā gaṇeśasya vakṣye nāmasahasrakam śrotuṃ nāmasahasraṃ me hṛdayaṃ protsukāyate mohena muhyate cetaste sarve baladarpitāḥ vighnā dūrāt palāyanta kālarudrādiva prajāḥ tamadyāpi gaṇeśānaṃ staumi nāmasahasrakaiḥ mahāgaṇapatervakṣye divyaṃ nāmasahasrakam duḥkhāpahaṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ mantranāmasahasrakam) guṇādyo nirguṇo goptā gajavaktro vibhāvasuḥ sadāśānto jagattāto [kh: jagattrātā] viśvakseno vibhākaraḥ aṇīyān vibhavī śreṣṭho jyeṣṭho gāthāpriyo guruḥ patiḥ pītavibhūṣāṅgo raktākṣo lohitāmbaraḥ surūpaḥ sāttvikaḥ satyaḥ śuddhaḥ śaṅkaranandanaḥ daityamardī madākṣībo madirāruṇalocanaḥ paraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sākṣī tryakṣo vikatthanaḥ bhṛṅgirīṭī bhṛṅgamālī bhṛṅgakūjitanāditaḥ vainateyo vinamrāṅgo viśvanetā vināyakaḥ puṣpadantaḥ puṣpahārī puṣpamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ antyo'ntakaścittagaṇaścittacintāpahārakaḥ lipito lohito lupto (100) lohitākṣo vilobhakaḥ sundaraḥ sundarīputraḥ samastāsuraghātanaḥ vicārī vāntado vāgmī vitarkī vijayeśvaraḥ vikartano viyaccārī vinaṭo nartako naṭaḥ viśvamūrviśvaghātī ca vinatāsyo vinartakaḥ kāruṇyarūpaḥ kuṭilaḥ kulācārī kuleśvaraḥ

rurū ramyamukho rakto revatīdayito rasaḥ unmattarūpaḥ kālāgniragnisūryendulocanaḥ asitātmā bhairaveśo bhāgyavān bhagavān bhagaḥ śubhaṅkaraḥ śuciḥ śāntaḥ śreṣyaḥ śravyaḥ śacīpatiḥ vidyāprado vedasāro vaidiko vedapāragaḥ (200) asanmayaḥ nirvairo vairividhvaṃsī mattavāraṇasannibhaḥ śvaityaḥ śvetaḥ śatamukho mugdho modakabhojanaḥ śuddhātmā śuddhamatimāñchuddhadīptiḥ śucivrataḥ dārakaḥ śikhivāheṣṭaḥ śītaḥ śaṅkaravallabhaḥ lūto līlārasollāsī vilāsī vibhramo bhramaḥ buddho vibudhasevyaśca budharājo balandharaḥ janako jinamārgajño jainamārganivartakaḥ paraṃ padaṃ paraṃ dhāma paramātmā kaviḥ kujaḥ grahendro grāhito grāhyo'graṇīrghurghuranāditaḥ vanecaro vanapatirvanavāsaḥ smaropamaḥ yaśasvī yajamāneṣṭo vajrabhṛd vajrapañjaraḥ mīnadhvajo manohārī yogināṃ yogavardhanaḥ tapomayastapomūrtistapanaśca tapodhanaḥ daṇḍī caṇḍāṃśuravyaktaḥ kamaṇḍaludharo'naghaḥ bhrāmako jātipūjyaśca jāḍyahā jaḍasūdanaḥ haviṣmān havyavāhākṣo hāṭako hāṭakāṅgadaḥ hālāpriyo hṛdāśāntaḥ kāntāhṛdayapoṣaṇaḥ kūvaro dhīmayo dhyātā dhyeyo dhīmān dayānidhiḥ nirgato naigamī gamyo nirjeyo jaṭilo'jaraḥ

cāmīkaranibho'nādyo [ṅ: nābhyaḥ] nalināyatalocanaḥ pañcabhūtātmakaḥ pañcasāyakaḥ pañcavaktakaḥ kaṭhorahṛdayo grīvālaṅkṛto lalitāśayaḥ dhruvo drutagatirdharmyo dharmī nākipriyo'nalaḥ sāgaraḥ svargatiḥ svakṣaḥ sānandaḥ sādhupūjitaḥ surāpriyo vasupatirvāsavo vasupūjitaḥ rājī rājīvanayanaḥ smṛtidaḥ kṛttikāmbaraḥ kṛttikāsanagaḥ kolo rohī rahaṇapādukaḥ mṛgarājo mṛgaśirā mādhavo madhuradhvaniḥ bhrūkṣepadattavibhavo bhrūkarālaḥ punarmayaḥ tittiristimiketuśca timicārakaghātanaḥ mānado mādhavo māgho vācālo maghavopamaḥ pūrvaphālgunikaḥ sphītaḥ phalguruttaraphālgunaḥ ghoṇāhastaścaturhasto hastivaktro halāyudhaḥ viśākhaḥ śikhisevyaśca śikhidhvajasahodaraḥ anūrādhāpriyo rādhyaḥ śrīmāñchuklaḥ śucismitaḥ śuciḥ pūrvastathāṣāḍhaścottarāṣāḍha īśvaraḥ śrāvaṇaḥ śravaṇaḥ śrotā dhanī dhanyo dhaniṣṭhakaḥ pūrvābhādrapado bhadraścottarābhādrapāditaḥ aśviyuk kārtikeyeṣṭo mārgaśīrṣo mṛgottamaḥ rājyado'bhijidātmīyastāreśaḥ tārakadyutiḥ parahā pañcabhūḥ pañcavāyuḥ pūjyaḥ paraṃ mahaḥ grāho meṣo vṛṣo mando manmatho mithunārcitaḥ kukkuṭo vanajo haṃsaḥ parahaṃsaḥ śṛgālakaḥ putrado narakatrātā kanyāprītaḥ kulodvahaḥ

alicāpadharo dhanvī kacchapo makaro maṇiḥ vasumūrtidharo vyagro'surahārī yamāntakaḥ aṅgadī kuṇḍalī bhaktipriyo bhaktavivardhanaḥ kātyāyanīsuto brahmapūjito vighnanāśanaḥ vighnāntako mahāgrīvo bhṛśaṃ modakamoditaḥ guhāśrayo viṣṇupadītanayaḥ sthānado dhruvaḥ caturdaśīpriyo mānyo vyavasāyo madānvitaḥ dhīraḥ śaktimatāṃ śreṣṭho mahābalasamanvitaḥ karaṇaṃ mṛtyuhārī ca pāpasaṅghanivartakaḥ bhūtacārī pretacārī buddhirūpo manomayaḥ tanmātrarūpo bhūtātmā indriyātmā vaśīkaraḥ nīrūpo bahurūpaśca kinnaro nāgavikramaḥ viśvakartā viśvabījaṃ (700) śrīḥ saṃpadhrīrdhṛtirmatiḥ saṃhartā sṛṣṭikartā ca sthitikartā layāśritaḥ ṛgīkṣaṇaḥ kāvyakartā śikṣākārī niruktavit vicāravāñśaṅkhadhārī satyavrataparāyaṇaḥ sarvasaṃpatkaro vyāpī meghagambhīranādabhṛt śambhubhaktirato mokṣadātā bhavadavānalaḥ prāṇado jñānamūrtiśca nādamūrtiyuto'kṣaraḥ kūṭasthaścetano rudraḥ kṣetravit puruṣo budhaḥ apratarkyavapuḥ skandānujo bhānurmahāprabhaḥ yajñagoptā yajñamayo dakṣayajñavināśakṛt ekadaṃṣṭraḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgo vikaṭo dhūmravarṇakaḥ suvarṇagarbhaḥ sumukhaḥ śrīkaraḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ svaṅgaḥ svakṣaḥ (800) śatānando lokavillokavigrahaḥ

pūrṇānandaḥ parānandaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ rāśitārāgrahamayastithirūpo [idaṃ nāmatrayam] jagadvibhuḥ trirūpaśca tṛtīyāgnistrayīrūpastrayītanuḥ ṣaḍrasāsvādako'jātaḥ ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭikavatsaraḥ aṣṭamīnandano'nārto navamībhaktibhāvitaḥ ekādaśātmā gaṇapo dvādaśīyugacarcitaḥ caturdaśendrasaṃstutyaḥ pūrṇimānandavigrahaḥ maunī madhuravāṅmūlaṃ mūrtimān meghavāhanaḥ raudro rudrapriyo rukmo rudraputro'ghatāpanaḥ gāndharvakuśalo'kuṇṭho vaikuṇṭho viṣṇusevitaḥ mañjulo mārjano matto durgāputro durālasaḥ bhāsvanmukuṭamāṇikyaḥ kūjatkiṅkiṇijālakaḥ padmākṣaḥ padmahastaśca (900) padmanābhasamarcitaḥ nārado vāraṇo lolaśravaṇaḥ śūrpakaśravāḥ ilāmaṇḍalasaṃbhrāntakṛtānugrahajīvakaḥ bṛhadāsyaravākrāntabhīmabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍakaḥ bṛhaddantakṛtātyugraraṇānandarasālasaḥ sphuratsindūravadanaḥ sphurattejognilocanaḥ calattoyapravāhāḍhyanadījalakaṇākulaḥ brahmācyutamahārudrapuraḥsarasurārcitaḥ gūrjatpañcānanārāvaprāptākāśadharātalaḥ pañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyamantramantritavigrahaḥ śaṅkhadhvanisamākrāntapātālādinabhastalaḥ kṛtatretāyugollāsabhāsamānajagattrayaḥ sudhāsiktavapurvyāptabrahmāṇḍādikaṭāhakaḥ

akārākāraprodgītatāranādanināditaḥ ukārokāraprodgārighoranāgopavītakaḥ ḷkārayutaḹkāraśaṅkhapūrṇadigantaraḥ okāraukāraviśvādikṛtasṛṣṭikramālasaḥ karṇatālakṛtātyuccairvāyuvījitanirjaraḥ garvitāśeṣagandharvagītatatparaśrotrakaḥ ṅavarṇāmṛtadhārāḍhyaśobhamānaikadantakaḥ chatracāmararatnāḍhyamukuṭālaṅkṛtānanaḥ jhāṃkārimadhupavrātagānanādanināditaḥ ṭaṅkārukaphalāsvādavepitāśeṣamūrdhajaḥ ṇavarṇāmṛtapīyūṣadhārādharasudhādharaḥ thakāradhanapaṅktyāḍhyasantoṣitadvijavrajaḥ dhanadādimahāyakṣasaṃsevitapadāmbujaḥ paravargāpavargādimārgacchedanadakṣakaḥ baddhabhrūyugabhīmograsaṃtarjitasurāsuraḥ madirākalaśasphītakarālaikakarāmbujaḥ ratnākarasutākāntakāntikīrtivivardhanaḥ varuṇādidigīśānaracitārcanacarcitaḥ ṣoḍaśasvaritālāpagītagānavicakṣaṇaḥ harādibrahmavaikuṇṭhabrahmagītādipāṭhakaḥ tārāṅkamantravarṇaikavigrahojjvalavigrahaḥ [kh: tārārṇa] oṃśrīṃvināyako oṃhrīṃvighnādhyakṣo gaṇādhipaḥ vedāntagīto vidyārthī śuddhamantraḥ [kh: siddha] ṣaḍakṣaraḥ saptakoṭimahāmantramantritāśeṣavigrahaḥ oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃdevo mahāgaṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ (1000)

guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ guptaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam grahatārāmayaṃ rāśivarṇapaṅktisamanvitam gaṇeśasya ca sarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ tridivaukasām aṣṭasiddhimayaṃ sādhyaṃ sādhakānāṃ jayapradam aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtimātrataḥ likhedbhūrje ravau devi puṇyaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasrakam yoṣidvāmakare baddhvā puruṣo dakṣiṇe bhuje vaśayedapi trailokyaṃ mārayedakhilān ripūn vandhyā putrāṃllabhecchīghraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt nagnaḥ śaktiyuto devi bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān ya enaṃ [g: idaṃ] paṭhate nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ bhaktipūrvakam raṇe rājabhaye dyūte paṭennāmnāṃ sahasrakam itīdaṃ puṇyasarvasvaṃ mantranāmasahasrakam mahāgaṇapatisahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ stotramaṅgatamaṃ brūhi mūlamantrasya tattvataḥ jīvasyāṅge [ṅ: devasyāgre] kalau śīghraṃ jīvanmuktipradāyakam ahibhūṣitakaṇṭhamakṣasūtraṃ bhramayantaṃ hṛdaye smare gaṇeśam vaśībhavanti tridive bhūmau samastā nṛpāḥ sakalakṣmāpatimūrdhasu sphuraccaraṇābjo bhuvi śobhate ca saḥ niścalā urvaśīvadanapadmaṣaṭpado dhīyate'dharaparāgakāmṛtam raṇe ripūnindrasamān vijitya prāpnoti rājyaṃ nṛpacakravartī carācare vai vicaredvimāne jagatyaśeṣāmaracakravartī gaṇakinnarasiddhasurāsurairnamito labhate gāṇapatyaṃ saḥ vadane vasate sadane vasate hṛdi vāk kamalā tava bhaktirapi

bhajanti te nandanacandanādivṛkṣeṣu līlāṃ surasundarībhiḥ vaśameti kinnarasutāpyurvaśī satataṃ suratadakṣā rogā aśeṣā vilayaṃ prayānti tamāṃsi sūrye'bhyudite yathāśu tryakṣamagnisadṛśaṃ smaranti ye te prayānti tridivaṃ vimānagāḥ tāvakapadaṃ devāsurairdurlabham sa sādhakaḥ pañcāṅgaṃ surasundari vinā śiṣyāya no dadyāt sādhakāya vinā tathā anyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt sarvathā dānamācaret stotranirūpaṇaṃ triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ bhairavaṃ candramukuṭaṃ gaṇagandharvasevitam bhasmāṅgarāgadhavalaṃ sarpagonasakaṅkaṇam kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamarudhāriṇam kāmakālāndhakabhayaṅkaram sādhyasiddhapiśācaugha bhairavapraṇataṃ prabhum gaṅgādharaṃ prasannāsyaṃ hasitānanapaṅkajam tvaṃ śivaḥ parameśānastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ prajāpatiḥ nirguṇo bhairavādhyakṣaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam tvaṃ me prāṇādhiko deva krītāsmi tava kiṅkarī adya tadvada tattvaṃ me yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā vismṛtaṃ vada me śīghraṃ vakṣye prāṇādhikāsi me sakalāgamasārajña kaulikānāṃ hitecchayā devadevasya sūryasya sarvatattvottamottamam sarvāgamarahasyaṃ te vakṣye snehena pārvati mantranāmasahasraṃ ca stotraṃ mūlātmakaṃ priye

athāhaṃ paṭalaṃ vakṣye mūlamantramayaṃ priye yo devadevo bhagavān bhāskarastejasāṃ nidhiḥ saviteti ca vedeṣu paramātmā jagatpatiḥ kālātmā ca paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmeti gīyate mantroddhāraṃ paraṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhimayaṃ kalau mantroddhāraḥ saviturvarṇitaste gurgākṣaro bhogamokṣaikahetuḥ na śaucaniyamo vāpi viparyayabhayaṃ nahi sarvārthasādhako devi na deyo yasya kasyacit kiṃ kiṃ na labhate mantrī vāñchitaṃ sūryamudraṇāt tarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ vaṭe'raṇye śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe sūryoparāgasamaye grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ mantrasyāsya mahādevi ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥ vyoṣaṃ bījaṃ parā śaktistāraṃ kīlakamīśvari māyābījena ṣaḍdīrghabhāginā nyāsamācaret kolatrayaṃ paṭhed devi japādau sādhakottamaḥ śarattrayaṃ paṭhenmadhye mūlamantrasya sādhakaḥ mātṛkāśodhitaṃ mantraṃ kṛtvā pārvati sādhakaḥ vedādiḍimbakāntyacchaṃ śaktirmadhye paṭhecchive iyaṃ śāpaharī vidyā japyā sādhakasattamaiḥ siddhaṃ mantraṃ japed devi yathāśaktyākṣamālayā jagadante paṭhed devi śaradvāraṃ ca kaulikaḥ gurūpadeśato jñeyaḥ sūryāstramanuruttamaḥ tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ ca sūryāya vidmahe tadanantaram tannaḥ śivaśca śaktiśca paramātmā pracodayāt

daśadhā sādhakairjapyā saṃdhyāsvarcāsu tarpaṇe sarvarogāpahaṃ devi bhogamokṣaphalapradam svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje sarvasaṃmohanaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhimayaṃ śive rekhātrayāñcitadharāsadanaṃ ca devi śrīcakrametaduditaṃ saviturvareṇyam yasya śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet seśāḥ pūjyā bahirdvāre yantrarājasya sādhakaiḥ antardvāsthāḥ śive pūjyā vāmāvartena sādhakaiḥ vṛttatraye'rcayenmantrī gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ketuṃ vasudale devi vāmāvṛtyārcayet sudhīḥ vidyutāṃ sarvatovaktrāṃ grahairvasudale'rcayet tvaṣṭāraṃ tapanaṃ dharmaṃ vasukoṇe samarcayet śrībindumaṇḍale devi savitāraṃ samarcayet tapinīṃ tāpinīṃ caiva bodhinīṃ caiva rodhinīm etāḥ saṃpūjya vasvaśre kaulikaḥ kulasiddhaye visphurāṃ savitāraṃ ca bindubimbe samarcayet suvarṇapadmaṃ saṃpūjya ratnāḍhyakalaśaṃ śive layāṅgametadākhyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam aṅguṣṭhau vimukhau madhye saṃyojya tarjanīdvayam padmamudreyamākhyātā bimbamudrāṃ śṛṇu priye ūrdhvaṃ karayugaṃ kṛtvā bimbamudreyamīritā tathaiva kaulikaḥ kuryādvāmataḥ savyato'ṅgulīḥ sarvarogāpahā khyātā darśanīyārcanāvidhau sitāsitau ca tarjanyoḥ rāhuketū pralambayoḥ āvāhane ca gandhādau naivedye ca visarjane

khaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā (sarvarogāpahāriṇī baddhvā muṣṭiyugaṃ devi parvaṃ parvaṇi yojayet khaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā) śatruvargavimardinī mahāmudrā mahāgopyā mahāmārtaṇḍavallabhā śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāphalamavāpnuyāt yeṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet vaśīkaraṇavidveṣau śāntikī pauṣṭikī kriyā aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ kalau rogāpahaṃ śive snātvā japenmahādevi sūryāgre sādhako'yutam sarpiṣā stambhanaṃ sadyo vāditaskarapāthasām [kh: vahni] huned daśāṃśamīśāni ghṛtapadmākṣanāgarān ravau sāyaṃ japenmūlaṃ nadītīrasthito rahaḥ ghṛtena dadhnā santarpya māraṇaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhavet huned daśāṃśamambhojaśaṭīghṛtakulatthakaiḥ ravau brāhme muhūrte tu snātvā tatra japejjale ghṛtamatsyaṇḍakarpūra padmapadmākṣakesarān sūryodaye japedvidyāṃ sādhako'yutasaṃkhyayā viṣeṇa tarpayed devaṃ bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ dviṣām ayutaṃ taddaśāṃśena huned ghṛtayavākaṇāḥ ativṛṣṭeranāvṛṣṭeḥ rājabhītermaheśvari mantrāyutaṃ mahādevi juhuyād ghṛtagopayaḥ daśāṃśaṃ tarpayed dadhnā kṣīreṇa sitayā sudhīḥ ityeṣa paṭalo guhyaḥ savituścātivallabhaḥ paṭalaḥ paddhatiṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram

sa pātakī bhavedrogī yadidaṃ śivaśāsanam sarvatattvarahasyāḍhyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ prāṇavallabhe dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ gāyatrīnāyako bhāsvān [k: śreṣṭhaḥ] saviteti pragīyate sarvamantramayaṃ guhyaṃ [k: divyaṃ] mūlavidyārahasyakam nivāraṇam] sarvatejomayaṃ sarvadevadānavapūjitam mātṛkāveṣṭitaṃ varma bhairavānananirgatam dhāraṇādasya deveśi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sarvalokeśo vāsavo'pi divaspatiḥ mantrātmakaṃ para varma savituḥ sāramuttamam sa rājavallabho loke tejasvī vairimardanaḥ iha lakṣmīdhanārogya vṛddhirbhavati nānyathā kavacasyāsya deveśi mūlavidyāmayasya ca gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥ sarvārthasādhane devi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ lalāṭaṃ me hrāṃ raviḥ pātu cinmayaḥ oṃauṃaṃaḥ śrutī pātu saḥ sarvajagadīśvaraḥ caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃ ca nāsāṃ me pāturyāṃ aryamā prabhuḥ taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ galaṃ pātu naṃ nārāyaṇavallabhaḥ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ bhujau pātu mūlaṃ sakalanāyakaḥ laṃkṣaḥ kukṣiṃ sadā pātu grahanātho dineśvaraḥ aṃāṃiṃīṃ uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ nābhiṃ pātu tamopahaḥ kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃcaṃ chaṃjaṃjhaṃ kaṭiṃ bhānurmamāvatu divākaraḥ]

ṅaṃñaṃṇaṃnaṃmaṃ me pātu savitā sakalaṃ vapuḥ budho māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nair-ṛtyām gurureva mām uttare māṃ tamaḥ pāyādaiśānyāṃ māṃ śikhī tathā prabhāte bhāskaraḥ pātu madhyāhne māṃ dineśvaraḥ sarvatra sarvadā sūryaḥ pātu māṃ cakranāyakaḥ saṅgrāme ca jvare roge pātu māṃ savitā prabhuḥ pāyānmāṃ kulanāyako'pi savitā oṃhrīṃhasauḥ sarvadā mūlavyāptatanuḥ sadāvatu paraṃ haṃsaḥ sahasrāṃśumān sarvadevarahasyaṃ ca mātṛkāmantraveṣṭitam [kh: varṇa] guhyaṃ yaśaskaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ śive aṣṭagandhena divyena sudhākṣīreṇa pārvati kanakīkāṣṭhalekhanyā kavacaṃ bhāskarodaye sauvarṇenātha saṃveṣṭya dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhuje rājamānyo bhavennityaṃ sarvatejomayo bhavet śiraḥsthā guṭikā divyā rājalokavaśaṅkarī vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganā yasya dehe bhavennityaṃ guṭikaiṣā maheśvari taddehaṃ prāpya vyarthāni bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ tasya sadyo mahādevi savitā varado bhavet tasya pūjārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ janmakoṭiṣu niṣphalam mahākuṣṭhārdito devi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ lakṣmīvāñjāyate devi sadyaḥ sūryaprasādataḥ muktimāpnuyāt trayastriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ tvaṃ me prāṇapriyā prītā varado'haṃ tava sthitaḥ

bhagavan devadeveśa mahārudra maheśvara devadevasya saviturvada nāmasahasrakam rahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ durlabhaṃ kāmanāvaham karmasākṣī jagaccakṣuḥ stotuṃ taṃ kena śakyate tasyādidevadevasya saviturjagadīśituḥ tantravedāgamoddhṛtam sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam vakṣyāmi paramaṃ tattvaṃ mūlavidyātmakaṃ param mantrāṇāmapi yat tattvaṃ mahasāmapi yanmahaḥ yogināmapi yo yogī vedānāṃ praṇavaśca yaḥ tārāṇāmapi yo rājā vāyūnāṃ ca prabhañjanaḥ nagānāmapi yo meruḥ pannagānāṃ ca vāsukiḥ savitā yastu gāyatryāḥ paramātmeti kīrtyate sarvadāridryaśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam jvararogāpamṛtyughnaṃ sadā sarvābhayapradam rājaprasādavijaya lakṣmīvibhavakāraṇam mohanastambhanākṛṣṭi vaśīkaraṇakāraṇam śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā sūryanāmasahasrakam sūryaṃ svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje saptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastamādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabje bhagavān sarvalokeśo bhūteśo bhūtabhāvanaḥ ādityo varado vīro vīralo viśvadīpanaḥ viśvātmā puruṣaḥ sākṣī [ṅ: sākṣāt] paraṃ brahma parāt paraḥ manuravyayaḥ bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyātmā tattvātmā jñānavān guṇī

sahasrakiraṇo bhāsvān bhārgavo bhṛgurīśvaraḥ tapasvī kālakṛt kālaḥ kamanīyatanuḥ kṛśaḥ dvibhujo'ṣṭabhujo dhīro daśabāhurdaśātigaḥ jaṭilo nirbhayo bhānuḥ padmahastaḥ kuśīrakaḥ mārtaṇḍo kokadhṛt trātā rudro bhadrapradaḥ prabhuḥ parākramaḥ] niyatātmā ca kāleśo dineśo bhaktavatsalaḥ vyomacārī mahān satyaḥ śambhurambhojavallabhaḥ trijaṭo raktavāhaśca raktavastro ratipriyaḥ gambhīraghoṣo nirghoṣo ghaṭahasto mahomayaḥ [k mayomayaḥ] sahasrahasto vijayo harigāmī harīśvaraḥ haimo hemakaro [g: haimakarī] hārī haridratnāsanasthitaḥ virocano vilāsī ca virūpākṣo vikartanaḥ matimān ratimān svakṣo viśālākṣo viśāṃpatiḥ gaṅgādharo gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇasevyo gaṇeśvaraḥ satyasandhaḥ sahasraguḥ mūrtimān (200) dūrdharo'mūrtistuṭirūpo lavātmakaḥ caṣako ghaṭikārūpo muhūrto dinarūpavān ayanaṃ yugarūpaśca kṛtaṃ tretāyugastripāt manvantarātmako devaḥ śakrastribhuvaneśvaraḥ [k: śaktiḥ] jalajāsanaḥ kalpāntakalanaḥ krūraḥ kālāgniḥ kālasūdanaḥ kālāvarto [gh: kalā] yugadharo yugādiḥ śahakeśvaraḥ acintyaḥ subalo bālo balākāvallabho varaḥ sāṃkhyeśvaro vedagamyo mantreśastantranāyakaḥ

alasastulasīsevyastuṣṭā roganivarhaṇaḥ vairāgyado vimānastho ratnakumbhadharāyudhaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpaśca tvaṣṭātharvaṇaśākhilaḥ [kh: śālinaḥ] kalpavṛkṣaśca mandāro (300) mandārācalaśobhanaḥ santānakusumacchannaḥ santānaphalado virāṭ varṣākālo varṣapatiḥ śaradambhojavallabhaḥ sumatiḥ sugatiḥ sādhurviṣṇuḥ sāmbo'mbikāsutaḥ sumeruśikharāvāsī saptapātālagocaraḥ surathaḥ sugatastutyo veṇuvādanatatparaḥ āvedanīyo vedākṣo mahādivyavapuḥ surāṭ vasurāvartano nityaḥ sarvāmnāyaprabhuḥ sudhīḥ trikoṇanilayaścetyo bindumaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ japākusumasaṅkāśo japapūjāphalapradaḥ sarvatattvāśrayo bradhno vīravandyo vibhāvasuḥ ādirādityalokeśaḥ sarvagāmī (400) kalāśrayaḥ vidyādhareśo vidyeśo yakṣeśo rakṣaṇo guruḥ apsarovandito'jayyo jetā daityanivarhaṇaḥ siddhasevyaḥ samāmnāyaḥ sādhusevyaḥ saritpatiḥ arko'rkakāntaratneśo'nantabāhuralopakaḥ akāramātṛkānātho devānāmādirākṛtiḥ ālokakṛt tathādityo vīrādityaḥ prajādhipaḥ indirāpūjitaścendurindralokāśrayastvinaḥ [g, gh: sthitaḥ] unnatāsyo'pyuruvapurunnatādricaro guruḥ [ṅ: guḍaḥ] ukārākārasukhitastathoṣmā nidhirūṣaṇaḥ ṛṇahartā ṝlihasta ṝṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ

eṇāṅkāmṛtadaścīnapaṭṭabhṛd bahugocaraḥ ekārabījaramaṇa eaioṣṭhāmṛtākaraḥ oaudantālirahito mahito mahatāṃ patiḥ aḥsvarūpaḥ (500) svaramayaḥ sarvasvaraparātmakaḥ karmaikavaradaḥ karmasākṣī kalmaṣanāśanaḥ keśārisūdanaḥ] kapālamocakaḥ kāśaḥ kāśmīraghanasārabhṛt kuvāsī kulakauleśaḥ kakārākṣaramaṇḍanaḥ khageśvaraśca khacaraḥ [kh: khecaraśca] khecarīgaṇasevitaḥ gantā gītapriyo geyo gayāvāsī gaṇāśrayaḥ sudhīḥ] ghaṭākaraḥ ṅānto ṅeśo ṅakārāṅgaścandrakuṅkumavāsitaḥ cāmīkaraprabhaścaṇḍabhānuścaṇḍeśavallabhaḥ calatpatākaścaṇḍādriścīvaraikadharo'caraḥ churikācchinnavigrahaḥ jambārirjaṅgiṭo [kh, g: jaṭilaḥ] jaṅgī janalokatamopahaḥ jagattrātā jagaddhātā jagaddhyeyo [k, kh: yoniḥ] jagannidhiḥ jakārākāramukuṭo jhañjāchannākṛtirjhaṭaḥ jhañākṣarāñcitaṣṭaṅkaṣṭiṭṭibhāsanasaṃsthitaḥ ḍambharo ḍāmarurḍiṇḍī ḍāmarīśo ḍalākṛtiḥ ṇeśapriyo ṇavarṇeśo ṇakārapadapaṅkajaḥ tripureśastrinetreśastrayītanuradhokṣajaḥ tandrāhartā tamorūpastapasāṃ phaladāyakaḥ cchedanodyanī]

dvādaśāntaikavasatirdvādaśātmā divaspatiḥ durdhyeyo duṣṭavaṃśaghno dayānātho dayākulaḥ dharmabandhurdharmanidhirdharmarājo dhanapradaḥ dhūrjaṭīkṣaṇavāsī ca dharmakṣetro dharādhipaḥ dharābhṛdvallabho dharmī dhakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥ nalinīvallabho nunno nāṭyakṛnnāṭyavardhanaḥ namonto namitārātirnaranārāyaṇāśrayaḥ nādarūpo [kh: nādapriyaḥ] nādamayo nādabindusvarūpakaḥ nākasthito'nekavapurnakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ prītipriyaḥ premakaraḥ praṇatārtibhayāpahaḥ pūrṇānandamayaḥ pūrṇatejāḥ pūrṇeśvarīśvaraḥ parameśavapuḥ prāṃśuḥ pramattaḥ praṇateṣṭadaḥ pācanaḥ piculaḥ pluṣṭaḥ pramadājanasaukhyadaḥ phalaṃ bhogāpavargasya phalinīśaḥ phalātmakaḥ bālo balapriyo bānto biladhvāntaharo [g, gh: hṛtaḥ] balī budho bṛhaspatirvṛkṣo bṛhadaśvo bṛhadgatiḥ bhago bhṛgurbhṛgusthāyī bhārgavaḥ kaviśekharaḥ mahākālo (800) mahādhyakṣo mahānādo mahāmatiḥ mānado mallahā mallo merumandaramandiraḥ modito madirāhāro mārtaṇḍo muṇḍamuṇḍitaḥ madālaso'marastutyo [g: malastutyaḥ] murārivarado manuḥ mālyavān medhano māro medhāvī musalāyudhaḥ madano [g: modanī] modakāhāro makārākṣaramātṛkaḥ yātriko yajñaphalado yāyī yāmalanāyakaḥ yaṣṭidhārī ca yantreśo yonimaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ

yoginīcakramadhyastho yugaleśvarapūjitaḥ rāmo ramaṇaśīlaśca ratnabhānū rurupriyaḥ ratnāṃśumālī ratnāḍhyo ratnakaṅkaṇanūpuraḥ rohiṇīśāśrayo rakṣākaro rātriñcarāntakaḥ lakṣmībhānurlatāvāsī lasatkāntiśca lokabhṛt loṅgeśvaro liṅganādo līlākārī lalambusaḥ vāmano vīravīrendro vācālo (900) vākpatipriyaḥ vāgbhavo vāliśadhvaṃsī vidyānāyakanāyakaḥ śaśī śobhākaraḥ śāntaḥ śāntikṛcchamanapriyaḥ śrutigamyaḥ śaradbījamaṇḍitaḥ śiṣṭasevitaḥ ṣaṭpadasvanasantoṣī ṣaḍāmnāyapravartakaḥ sūryabhānuḥ sūrabhānuḥ sūribhānuḥ sukhākaraḥ samastasādhakeśānaḥ samastakulaśekharaḥ haritsūryo haridbhānurhavirbhug havyavāhanaḥ hrāṃbījasūryo hrīṃsūryo hakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ kṣutsūryaḥ kṣāntasūryaśca laṃkṣaḥsūryaḥ sadāśivaḥ bhūḥsūryaśca bhuvaḥsūryaḥ svaḥsūryaḥ sūryanāyakaḥ rāśisūryo yogasūryo mantrasūryo manūttamaḥ rudrasūryo brahmasūryo vīrasūryo varottamaḥ itīdaṃ devadeveśi mantranāmasahasrakam sarvasāramayaṃ divyaṃ brahmatejovivardhanam sarvayajñaphalaistulyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam sarvavrataphalodriktaṃ sarvadharmaphalapradam prabhāvamasya deveśi nāmnāṃ sahasrakasya ca yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhiṃdhyāyed devānāmapi durlabham

yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayedvāpi ṛṇoti niyatendriyaḥ dhanavāñjāyate loke putravān rājavallabhaḥ ravau paṭhenmahādevi sūryaṃ saṃpūjya kaulikaḥ saṃkrāntau yaḥ paṭhed devi trikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakam saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe yaḥ paṭhedastaṃgate ravau vyatīpāte paṭhed devi madhyāhne saṃyatendriyaḥ cakrārcane paṭhed devi japan mūlaṃ raviṃ smaran sarvaśatrūn vijityāśu labhellakṣmīṃ pratāpavān kāntāśrito vītabhayo bhavet sa śivasannibhaḥ savitā sarvalokeśo varadaḥ sahasā bhavet iha lakṣmīṃ sadā bhuktvā paratrāpnoti tatpadam aṣṭagandhena divyena nīlapuṣpaharidrayā vilikhya vidhivanmantrī yantramadhye'rṇaveṣṭitam kanyākartitasūtreṇa veṣṭayedraktalākṣayā sādhayenmantrarājena dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhuje kuṣṭharogī ca śūlī ca pramehī kukṣirogavān mucyate sahasā dhṛtvā guṭīmetāṃ sudurlabhām dhārayedguṭikāmetāṃ vakṣasi smayatarpitā mṛtavatsā bahūn putrān surūpāṃśa cirāyuṣaḥ akṣatāṅgo mahārājaḥ sukhī svapuramāviśet guṭikāṃ mohanākarṣastambhanoccāṭanakṣamām dhanena dhanado devi vibhavena ca śaṃkaraḥ girā bṛhaspatirdevi nayena bhṛgunandanaḥ ārogyeṇa ghaṭodbhūtiḥ kāntyā pūrṇendusannibhaḥ gāmbhīryeṇa tathāmbhodhirdātṛtvena baliḥ svayam

kiṃ pralāpena bahunā paṭhedvā dhārayecchive sa bhaved bhāskaraḥ sākṣāt paramānandavigrahaḥ idaṃ divyaṃ mahat tattvaṃ sūryanāmasahasrakam abhaktāya kucailāya paraśiṣyāya pārvati gurubhaktivihīnāya nindakāya śivāgame kulīnāya subhaktāya sūryabhaktiratāya ca sarvamantramayaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat catustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ pañcamāṅgamayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvāpattāraṇaṃ dhruvam sarvāmayapraśamanaṃ tejobalavivardhanam bhogāpavargadaṃ loke rahasyaṃ mama pārvati gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥ praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi viśvaṃ digbandhanaṃ tataḥ visphurāliṅgitaṃ dhyātvā stotrametadudīrayet svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje [k, kh, g: jīyate] drāk surasadasi sudhāpūritābhiśca vāgbhiḥ parāsustava padam gadyādipadyāmṛtavarṣiṇī vāg vaktre vibho tasya karasthitā śrīḥ bhagavan dhāmāvyayaṃ yāsyati bhagavan vaśyāḥ sadā saṃpadaḥ majātejasvino māninaḥ manasi sarasijeṣṭaṃ sūryamīśaṃ namāmi bhagavantamanantamādyam dhāma savituḥ tava snehānmayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit
